mainEntity.name: Is it OK if my gums bleed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Though bleeding gums are common in most of the people, it's not OK. Gums will never bleed if they are healthy. Root Canal Treatment in Kothrud - Save Your Tooth, End the Pain
Trusted, Painless Root Canal Treatment Near Me in Kothrud | The Dental Studio
Experiencing severe tooth pain? Don’t wait. At The Dental Studio in Kothrud, Pune, we help you save your natural tooth with gentle, precise root canal care - in as little as a single sitting.
What Is Root Canal Treatment? And Do You Actually Need One?
Most people dread the words “root canal” - but here’s the truth: the procedure doesn’t cause pain, it relieves it.
Root canal treatment (RCT) is a dental procedure that removes infected or damaged pulp from inside your tooth, cleans and shapes the root canals, and seals the tooth to prevent further infection. When a tooth’s inner nerve becomes infected - due to deep decay, a crack, or trauma - the pain can be unbearable. Root canal treatment is what stops it.
At The Dental Studio, our experienced dental team has performed hundreds of successful root canal procedures for patients across Kothrud, Karve Road, Mayur Colony, and surrounding areas of Pune. Whether you are dealing with a throbbing toothache at midnight or a cavity that went a little too far, we are here - and we make the process as comfortable as modern dentistry allows.
If you’ve been searching for root canal treatment near me in Kothrud, you’ve found the right place.
10 Signs You May Need Root Canal Treatment
Before the chair, clarity comes. Here’s what your tooth might be trying to tell you:
Persistent, severe toothache that doesn’t go away with painkillers
Sensitivity to hot or cold that lingers long after the food or drink is gone
Swollen or tender gums around a specific tooth
Darkening or discolouration of the tooth
A small pimple or bump on the gum (dental abscess)
Pain when biting or chewing
Cracked or chipped tooth with inner nerve exposure
Tooth pain that radiates to the jaw, ear, or temple
Loose tooth with no visible trauma or accident
Bad taste or bad breath that persists even after brushing
If you identify with any of these signs, we strongly recommend scheduling a consultation. Early intervention saves teeth - and saves money.
Root Canal Treatment in Kothrud - Our 5-Step Procedure
Step 1 - Dental Examination & Digital X-Ray
Our dentist examines the affected tooth and takes a digital X-ray to assess infection depth and canal anatomy.
Step 2 - Local Anaesthesia & Pulp Access
We administer local anaesthesia for a completely painless experience, then open the tooth to access the infected pulp.
Step 3 - Infection Removal & Canal Cleaning
Using precision instruments, we remove all infected pulp tissue and bacteria from the root canals.
Step 4 - Canal Shaping, Disinfection & Filling
The canals are shaped, irrigated with disinfectant solution, and filled with biocompatible gutta-percha material.
Step 5 - Crown Placement for Long-Term Protection
A dental crown is placed over the treated tooth to restore strength, function, and natural appearance completely.
Why Choose Root Canal Treatment in Kothrud at The Dental Studio?
Root canal treatment is one of the most misunderstood procedures in dentistry. People put it off out of fear - and end up losing a tooth they could have saved. Here’s why patients across Kothrud, Karve Road, and Mayur Colony trust The Dental Studio for their root canal needs:
Painless Procedure with Modern Anaesthesia We use the latest local anaesthetic techniques to ensure you feel nothing during the procedure. Most patients are surprised at how comfortable and quick it is.
Experienced Root Canal Specialists Our dental team includes trained endodontists - root canal specialist doctors - who handle both routine and complex cases, including wisdom tooth root canals.
Advanced Digital X-Ray & Equipment We use digital radiography for precision diagnosis and rotary endodontic instruments for faster, more accurate canal cleaning - minimising treatment time and discomfort.
Transparent Pricing, No Hidden Costs We believe in honest communication. Before any treatment begins, you’ll know the exact cost, the number of sittings, and what to expect at every stage.
Whether you need the best dentist for root canal treatment in Kothrud or simply want to understand your options before committing - our team is here to guide you with zero pressure.
Steps in Root Canal Treatment We Offer
What Is Root Canal Treatment? And Do You Actually Need One?
At The Dental Studio, we offer a full spectrum of root canal-related procedures tailored to each patient’s condition. Here’s a complete overview:
Dental Checkup & X-Ray
A thorough clinical examination paired with digital X-rays to diagnose infection, decay depth, and the exact condition of your tooth’s root canals before treatment begins.
Pulp Removal (Infection Cleaning)
The infected or inflamed pulp - the soft tissue inside the tooth containing nerves and blood vessels - is carefully removed to eliminate the source of pain and bacteria.
Root Canal Cleaning & Shaping
Using specialised rotary files, the internal canals are cleaned, shaped, and widened to remove all debris and prepare the space for safe, complete filling.
Medicine Filling (Intracanal Medicament)
An antimicrobial paste or medicine is placed inside the cleaned canals between sittings to eliminate residual bacteria and reduce inflammation before the final seal.
Canal Filling - Gutta Percha Filling
The cleaned canals are permanently sealed with gutta-percha, a biocompatible rubber-like material that fits precisely into the canal space, preventing reinfection long-term.
Temporary Filling
A temporary material is placed to close the tooth access opening between visits, protecting the canals from contamination while the tooth is monitored for healing.
Permanent Tooth Filling (Core Build-Up)
Once the root canal is complete, a permanent composite or GIC filling restores the inner tooth structure, providing the foundation needed before crown placement.
Dental Crown / Cap After Root Canal
A ceramic or zirconia crown is placed over the treated tooth to restore full biting function, protect the brittle post-RCT tooth, and match your natural smile seamlessly.
Re-Root Canal Treatment (Retreatment RCT)
When a previously treated tooth becomes reinfected, we carefully remove old filling material, re-clean the canals, and re-seal them to restore the tooth’s health effectively.
Post & Core Build-Up
In cases where the tooth structure is significantly damaged, a post is placed inside the canal to anchor a core build-up, which then supports the final crown restoration.
Single Sitting RCT / Multiple Sitting RCT
Depending on the severity of infection and tooth condition, your root canal may be completed in one visit (single sitting RCT) or spread across two to three appointments for optimal results.
Is Root Canal Treatment in Kothrud Painful? Here's the Honest Answer
This is the question we hear the most - and the honest answer might surprise you.
The tooth infection is painful. The root canal treatment itself, performed under local anaesthesia, is not.
Modern dentistry has transformed root canal procedures. With today’s rotary instruments, digital imaging, and effective anaesthetics, most patients compare the experience to getting a standard filling. The procedure typically takes 45 to 90 minutes per sitting, and you’ll be able to return to normal activities the same day.
Some mild soreness or sensitivity around the treated tooth is normal for 2–3 days after the procedure. This is simply your body healing - and it’s manageable with over-the-counter pain relief.
What we promise: you will leave our clinic with less pain than you arrived with.
Root Canal for Wisdom Tooth - Is It Possible?
Absolutely. Root canal treatment in Kothrud for wisdom teeth is one of the specialised services we offer at The Dental Studio.
Wisdom teeth (third molars) can be treated with root canal therapy when they are properly positioned, have enough bone support, and are worth saving. If the wisdom tooth is severely impacted or cannot be restored, extraction may be recommended instead. Our expert will evaluate your specific case and give you the most honest and conservative recommendation.
Who Is the Right Dentist for Your Root Canal in Kothrud?
Not all root canals are the same - and not all dentists are trained equally in endodontic procedures.
At The Dental Studio, our root canal specialist in Kothrud brings focused expertise in diagnosing and treating pulp infections across all tooth types, including molars with complex multi-canal anatomy. As the best root canal dentist in Kothrud, we combine clinical skill with a genuine commitment to your comfort throughout the entire treatment journey.

Karve Road - the best dental clinic in Karve Road for root canal is closer than you think

What Happens If You Ignore a Tooth That Needs Root Canal?
This is an important conversation to have - because delay has real consequences.
An infected tooth does not heal on its own. Without root canal treatment, the infection:
Spreads to surrounding teeth and jawbone
Forms a painful abscess that may require surgical drainage
Leads to tooth loss - which then requires an implant or bridge (far more expensive)
Can affect your overall health if bacteria enter the bloodstream
Root canal treatment in Kothrud Pune Maharashtra, when done on time, has a success rate of over 95%. The tooth you save today can last a lifetime with proper care. The tooth you ignore today may be gone within months.
Root Canal Aftercare - What to Do After Your Procedure
Once your root canal is complete, a little care goes a long way:
Avoid chewing on the treated tooth until the permanent crown is placed
Take prescribed antibiotics and pain medication as directed
Eat soft foods for the first 24–48 hours
Brush and floss gently around the treated area
Attend follow-up appointments as scheduled
Get the dental crown placed promptly - an uncrowned tooth after RCT is vulnerable to fracture
With proper aftercare and a well-fitted crown, your root canal-treated tooth can function just like a natural tooth for many years.

At The Dental Studio, we understand that visiting a dentist - especially for something like a root canal - takes courage. Our team is trained not just in dentistry but in making you feel heard, comfortable, and confident at every step.
Whether you’ve been in pain for days or just discovered a cavity that’s gone a little deep, this is your sign to act. The best root canal treatment in Kothrud isn’t the cheapest or the quickest - it’s the one that’s done right, with the right team, the first time.

Smile Designing Treatment in Kothrud
As a comprehensive Cosmetic Smile Design in Kothrud provider, we offer the full spectrum of smile enhancement procedures. Below is a complete overview of every treatment available at our clinic.
Teeth Whitening
Professional teeth whitening at The Dental Studio uses the highest quality of clinical-grade whitening agents combined with latest technology to remove deep stains and discoloration, delivering a smile that is visibly brighter by several shades in a single session.
Our in-clinic whitening is safe, supervised, and dramatically more effective than any over-the-counter product you will find in a pharmacy. Whether your stains are from coffee, tea, or tobacco, our dentists assess the cause and choose the most effective whitening protocol for your specific case.
Patients searching for Smile Designing Karve Road Pune often begin their smile journey with teeth whitening - it is the fastest, most accessible entry point into cosmetic dentistry with zero recovery time.
Dental Veneers
Dental veneers are ultra-thin shells of porcelain or composite resin bonded to the front surface of your teeth to correct shape, colour, size, and minor misalignment issues simultaneously.
Veneers are arguably the most transformative single treatment in cosmetic dentistry. A set of eight to ten porcelain veneers can completely redefine your smile, and when done correctly, they are virtually indistinguishable from natural teeth. At The Dental Studio, we use IPS e.max ceramic veneers - the gold standard in cosmetic dental materials - for results that are stain-resistant, durable, and exquisitely lifelike.
Our Smile Makeover Clinic Karve Road approach to veneers always begins with a Digital Smile Design mockup so you can approve the shape and shade before any irreversible preparation takes place. You are always in control of your outcome.
Dental Bonding
Dental bonding is a quick, minimally invasive treatment in which tooth-coloured composite resin is sculpted directly onto your teeth to repair chips, close small gaps, or correct minor shape irregularities.
Unlike veneers, bonding requires no laboratory time and can often be completed in a single appointment. It is the ideal solution for patients with isolated cosmetic concerns who want immediate, affordable results without extensive preparation. The material is carefully shade-matched to blend seamlessly with your natural teeth.
The Best Smile Designing Dentist in Karve Road understands that not every patient needs an extensive makeover. Sometimes a single bonded tooth makes the most meaningful difference in a person’s confidence.
Clear Aligners / Braces
Misaligned, crowded, or spaced teeth are not just an aesthetic issue - they affect your bite, your oral hygiene, and your long-term dental health. Clear aligners offer a virtually invisible orthodontic solution for adults and teenagers alike.
At The Dental Studio, we provide both clear aligner therapy (including internationally accredited brands) and traditional orthodontic braces depending on your case complexity and lifestyle preference. Our Smile Designing Dentist in Karve Road maps out your entire alignment journey digitally, so you know exactly how your teeth will move over time.
Most aligner cases are completed between 12 and 24 months, with results that improve not just appearance but function. Properly aligned teeth are easier to clean, less prone to wear, and significantly reduce the risk of jaw joint problems in the future.
Dental Crowns
A dental crown is a full-coverage restoration that encases a damaged, weakened, or heavily restored tooth to restore its shape, strength, and appearance. In cosmetic smile design, crowns play a critical role in rebuilding heavily worn or structurally compromised teeth while achieving an aesthetic result.
At The Dental Studio, we fabricate crowns using pressed ceramic and zirconia materials that mimic the translucency and texture of natural enamel. When used as part of a comprehensive Smile Designing Treatment in Karve Road, crowns dramatically improve the overall harmony of your smile, especially in cases where veneers alone cannot achieve the desired correction.
Full-arch smile makeovers involving multiple crowns are among our most transformative cases - and among our most requested treatments by patients who have suffered years of dental neglect.
Smile Makeover
A smile makeover is the comprehensive version of smile designing - it combines two or more cosmetic dental procedures into one cohesive treatment plan to achieve a complete, harmonious transformation of your smile.
At The Dental Studio, our Dental Clinic for Smile Designing in Karve Road specialises in full-mouth smile makeovers that may include teeth whitening, veneers, crowns, gum contouring, and alignment correction - all coordinated and sequenced for the most efficient, comfortable, and beautiful result possible.
Smile makeovers are ideal for patients who have multiple cosmetic concerns they want addressed simultaneously. We work with your timeline, your budget, and your aesthetic preferences to build a plan that delivers maximum impact. Many of our most dramatic before-and-after cases begin with the simple decision to book a smile makeover consultation.
Dental Implants
When missing teeth are part of the smile design picture, dental implants are the gold standard solution. A dental implant is a titanium post placed into the jawbone that acts as a permanent artificial tooth root, topped with a ceramic crown that matches your surrounding teeth precisely.
Unlike bridges or dentures, implants preserve the jawbone, feel completely natural, and last a lifetime with proper care. At The Dental Studio, implant placement is performed by experienced implantologists using guided surgical protocols for precision and predictability. If you are working with a Dentist for Smile Designing in Karve Road and have missing teeth as part of your concerns, implants are often an essential component of the overall plan.
We also offer implant-supported bridges for patients with multiple missing teeth, and full-arch implant solutions for those who have lost most or all of their natural dentition.
Tooth Contouring & Reshaping
Sometimes all it takes to dramatically improve a smile is subtle reshaping of a few teeth. Tooth contouring is a non-invasive procedure in which small amounts of enamel are carefully removed to correct minor length inconsistencies, pointed edges, or irregular shapes.
This procedure rarely requires anesthesia, causes no discomfort, and delivers instantly visible results. It is frequently combined with dental bonding or whitening for a comprehensive yet minimal-intervention smile refresh. For patients who are close to loving their smile and just need minor refinements, tooth contouring is a fast, affordable, and highly satisfying solution.
Gap Closure Treatment
Gaps between teeth - known clinically as diastemas - are among the most common cosmetic dental concerns. They can be addressed through multiple techniques depending on the size of the gap and the overall dental anatomy of the patient.
At The Dental Studio, gap closure may be achieved through dental bonding, porcelain veneers, clear aligners, or a combination approach. Our team evaluates your case comprehensively to recommend the most conservative and long-lasting method. Dentists for Smile Designing Near Me in Kothrud searches frequently lead patients to us specifically for gap closure - and consistently, they are amazed by how naturally their new smile looks once the space is closed.
Composite Fillings (Tooth-Coloured Fillings)
Old silver (amalgam) fillings in visible teeth can significantly detract from an otherwise beautiful smile. Composite fillings are tooth-coloured restorations made from a durable resin material that is shade-matched precisely to your natural teeth, making them completely invisible.
Replacing old amalgam fillings with composite restorations is a simple but impactful step in any smile makeover. Beyond aesthetics, composite fillings are mercury-free, bond directly to tooth structure (unlike amalgam), and require less tooth removal during preparation. Many of our patients are surprised to learn how dramatically removing silver fillings improves their overall smile appearance.
Many patients feel a mix of excitement and nervousness before their first consultation. We want you to know exactly what to expect so you walk in feeling prepared and comfortable.
Your consultation begins with a conversation, not a procedure. Our dentist will sit with you, listen to your specific concerns, understand what you like and dislike about your current smile, and learn about your lifestyle, professional environment, and aesthetic preferences. This is your time to speak - and we mean that genuinely.
After the conversation, we move into the clinical assessment. This involves a full oral health examination including digital X-rays, intraoral photographs, and a bite analysis. We evaluate the health of your gums, the condition of existing restorations, and the structural integrity of each tooth. We need to know the full picture before designing the ideal solution.
Then comes the exciting part - the Digital Smile Design preview. Using your photographs and our design software, we create a digital mock-up of your proposed new smile. In many cases, we can also create a physical mock-up using temporary composite resin placed directly on your teeth, so you can see and feel the result before any permanent work begins.
Finally, you receive your complete, personalised treatment plan in writing - including every procedure recommended, the sequence, the timeline, and the full cost breakdown. No pressure, no urgency, no sales tactics. Just information, delivered with respect.
This is what it means to visit the Best Smile Designing Clinic in Kothrud - a clinic where the consultation itself feels like a service, not just a gateway to billing.
Many of our smile designing patients are professionals - doctors, lawyers, corporate executives, entrepreneurs, educators, and performers - who understand that their smile is part of their professional identity. A confident smile communicates competence, warmth, and authority without saying a word. In high-stakes professional environments, this matters.
We also regularly serve patients preparing for weddings, milestone birthday celebrations, family reunions, international travel, or major career transitions who want to look and feel their absolute best for a defining moment in their lives.
As the most sought-after Kothrud Dentists Smile Design destination, we are accustomed to working with professional timelines and delivering results within specific date targets. If you have an upcoming event and a smile goal, tell us your date at the consultation - we will build a plan that works within your timeline.
For brides and grooms in particular, we recommend beginning your smile designing journey at least six months before your wedding date to allow time for alignment correction, whitening, and veneer fabrication without rushing any stage of the process. A rushed smile design is a compromised one - and your wedding photographs last forever.
Most patients think about smile designing purely in terms of tooth colour and shape. Our dentists think about far more than that - and this depth of analysis is what separates exceptional results from average ones.
Facial Proportions: We evaluate the “golden ratio” of your facial thirds - forehead, mid-face, and lower third - to determine ideal tooth length and width proportions that are harmonious with your overall facial structure.
Lip Dynamics: Your smile is framed by your lips. We analyse how much of your upper teeth are visible at rest and at full smile, and how your lower teeth appear during speech. This guides decisions about tooth length, angle, and exposure.
Midline Alignment: The centre line between your two upper front teeth ideally aligns with the centre of your face and the tip of your nose. Even a one-millimetre midline deviation is noticeable to the trained eye - and correcting it transforms smile symmetry.
Gingival Contour: The scallop shape and height of your gum line across all visible teeth should follow a predictable, aesthetically pleasing pattern. Irregularities here - even subtle ones - disrupt the visual flow of the smile.
Tooth Proportions and Incisal Edge: The width-to-height ratio of each tooth, the shape of the incisal (biting) edge, the degree of translucency at the tips - all of these details are carefully planned and executed in every smile we design.
This level of scientific and artistic analysis is what defines Smile Designing in Kothrud at The Dental Studio. It is not just dentistry. It is precision aesthetics - and it shows in every result we deliver.

Our in-clinic whitening is safe, supervised, and dramatically more effective than any over-the-counter product you will find in a pharmacy. Whether your stains are from coffee, tea, or tobacco, our dentists assess the cause and choose the most effective whitening protocol for your specific case.

Patients searching for Smile Designing Karve Road Pune often begin their smile journey with teeth whitening - it is the fastest, most accessible entry point into cosmetic dentistry with zero recovery time.

Dental Veneers

Dental veneers are ultra-thin shells of porcelain or composite resin bonded to the front surface of your teeth to correct shape, colour, size, and minor misalignment issues simultaneously.

Veneers are arguably the most transformative single treatment in cosmetic dentistry. A set of eight to ten porcelain veneers can completely redefine your smile, and when done correctly, they are virtually indistinguishable from natural teeth. At The Dental Studio, we use IPS e.max ceramic veneers - the gold standard in cosmetic dental materials - for results that are stain-resistant, durable, and exquisitely lifelike.

Our Smile Makeover Clinic Karve Road approach to veneers always begins with a Digital Smile Design mockup so you can approve the shape and shade before any irreversible preparation takes place. You are always in control of your outcome.

Dental Bonding

Dental bonding is a quick, minimally invasive treatment in which tooth-coloured composite resin is sculpted directly onto your teeth to repair chips, close small gaps, or correct minor shape irregularities.

Unlike veneers, bonding requires no laboratory time and can often be completed in a single appointment. It is the ideal solution for patients with isolated cosmetic concerns who want immediate, affordable results without extensive preparation. The material is carefully shade-matched to blend seamlessly with your natural teeth.

The Best Smile Designing Dentist in Karve Road understands that not every patient needs an extensive makeover. Sometimes a single bonded tooth makes the most meaningful difference in a person’s confidence.

Clear Aligners / Braces

Misaligned, crowded, or spaced teeth are not just an aesthetic issue - they affect your bite, your oral hygiene, and your long-term dental health. Clear aligners offer a virtually invisible orthodontic solution for adults and teenagers alike.

At The Dental Studio, we provide both clear aligner therapy (including internationally accredited brands) and traditional orthodontic braces depending on your case complexity and lifestyle preference. Our Smile Designing Dentist in Karve Road maps out your entire alignment journey digitally, so you know exactly how your teeth will move over time.

Most aligner cases are completed between 12 and 24 months, with results that improve not just appearance but function. Properly aligned teeth are easier to clean, less prone to wear, and significantly reduce the risk of jaw joint problems in the future.

Dental Crowns

A dental crown is a full-coverage restoration that encases a damaged, weakened, or heavily restored tooth to restore its shape, strength, and appearance. In cosmetic smile design, crowns play a critical role in rebuilding heavily worn or structurally compromised teeth while achieving an aesthetic result.

At The Dental Studio, we fabricate crowns using pressed ceramic and zirconia materials that mimic the translucency and texture of natural enamel. When used as part of a comprehensive Smile Designing Treatment in Karve Road, crowns dramatically improve the overall harmony of your smile, especially in cases where veneers alone cannot achieve the desired correction.

Full-arch smile makeovers involving multiple crowns are among our most transformative cases - and among our most requested treatments by patients who have suffered years of dental neglect.

Smile Makeover

A smile makeover is the comprehensive version of smile designing - it combines two or more cosmetic dental procedures into one cohesive treatment plan to achieve a complete, harmonious transformation of your smile.

At The Dental Studio, our Dental Clinic for Smile Designing in Karve Road specialises in full-mouth smile makeovers that may include teeth whitening, veneers, crowns, gum contouring, and alignment correction - all coordinated and sequenced for the most efficient, comfortable, and beautiful result possible.

Smile makeovers are ideal for patients who have multiple cosmetic concerns they want addressed simultaneously. We work with your timeline, your budget, and your aesthetic preferences to build a plan that delivers maximum impact. Many of our most dramatic before-and-after cases begin with the simple decision to book a smile makeover consultation.

Dental Implants

When missing teeth are part of the smile design picture, dental implants are the gold standard solution. A dental implant is a titanium post placed into the jawbone that acts as a permanent artificial tooth root, topped with a ceramic crown that matches your surrounding teeth precisely.

Unlike bridges or dentures, implants preserve the jawbone, feel completely natural, and last a lifetime with proper care. At The Dental Studio, implant placement is performed by experienced implantologists using guided surgical protocols for precision and predictability. If you are working with a Dentist for Smile Designing in Karve Road and have missing teeth as part of your concerns, implants are often an essential component of the overall plan.

We also offer implant-supported bridges for patients with multiple missing teeth, and full-arch implant solutions for those who have lost most or all of their natural dentition.

Tooth Contouring & Reshaping

Sometimes all it takes to dramatically improve a smile is subtle reshaping of a few teeth. Tooth contouring is a non-invasive procedure in which small amounts of enamel are carefully removed to correct minor length inconsistencies, pointed edges, or irregular shapes.

This procedure rarely requires anesthesia, causes no discomfort, and delivers instantly visible results. It is frequently combined with dental bonding or whitening for a comprehensive yet minimal-intervention smile refresh. For patients who are close to loving their smile and just need minor refinements, tooth contouring is a fast, affordable, and highly satisfying solution.

Gap Closure Treatment

Gaps between teeth - known clinically as diastemas - are among the most common cosmetic dental concerns. They can be addressed through multiple techniques depending on the size of the gap and the overall dental anatomy of the patient.

At The Dental Studio, gap closure may be achieved through dental bonding, porcelain veneers, clear aligners, or a combination approach. Our team evaluates your case comprehensively to recommend the most conservative and long-lasting method. Dentists for Smile Designing Near Me in Kothrud searches frequently lead patients to us specifically for gap closure - and consistently, they are amazed by how naturally their new smile looks once the space is closed.

Composite Fillings (Tooth-Coloured Fillings)

Old silver (amalgam) fillings in visible teeth can significantly detract from an otherwise beautiful smile. Composite fillings are tooth-coloured restorations made from a durable resin material that is shade-matched precisely to your natural teeth, making them completely invisible.

Replacing old amalgam fillings with composite restorations is a simple but impactful step in any smile makeover. Beyond aesthetics, composite fillings are mercury-free, bond directly to tooth structure (unlike amalgam), and require less tooth removal during preparation. Many of our patients are surprised to learn how dramatically removing silver fillings improves their overall smile appearance.

Many patients feel a mix of excitement and nervousness before their first consultation. We want you to know exactly what to expect so you walk in feeling prepared and comfortable.

Your consultation begins with a conversation, not a procedure. Our dentist will sit with you, listen to your specific concerns, understand what you like and dislike about your current smile, and learn about your lifestyle, professional environment, and aesthetic preferences. This is your time to speak - and we mean that genuinely.

After the conversation, we move into the clinical assessment. This involves a full oral health examination including digital X-rays, intraoral photographs, and a bite analysis. We evaluate the health of your gums, the condition of existing restorations, and the structural integrity of each tooth. We need to know the full picture before designing the ideal solution.

Then comes the exciting part - the Digital Smile Design preview. Using your photographs and our design software, we create a digital mock-up of your proposed new smile. In many cases, we can also create a physical mock-up using temporary composite resin placed directly on your teeth, so you can see and feel the result before any permanent work begins.

Finally, you receive your complete, personalised treatment plan in writing - including every procedure recommended, the sequence, the timeline, and the full cost breakdown. No pressure, no urgency, no sales tactics. Just information, delivered with respect.

This is what it means to visit the Best Smile Designing Clinic in Kothrud - a clinic where the consultation itself feels like a service, not just a gateway to billing.

Many of our smile designing patients are professionals - doctors, lawyers, corporate executives, entrepreneurs, educators, and performers - who understand that their smile is part of their professional identity. A confident smile communicates competence, warmth, and authority without saying a word. In high-stakes professional environments, this matters.

We also regularly serve patients preparing for weddings, milestone birthday celebrations, family reunions, international travel, or major career transitions who want to look and feel their absolute best for a defining moment in their lives.

As the most sought-after Kothrud Dentists Smile Design destination, we are accustomed to working with professional timelines and delivering results within specific date targets. If you have an upcoming event and a smile goal, tell us your date at the consultation - we will build a plan that works within your timeline.

For brides and grooms in particular, we recommend beginning your smile designing journey at least six months before your wedding date to allow time for alignment correction, whitening, and veneer fabrication without rushing any stage of the process. A rushed smile design is a compromised one - and your wedding photographs last forever.

Most patients think about smile designing purely in terms of tooth colour and shape. Our dentists think about far more than that - and this depth of analysis is what separates exceptional results from average ones.

Facial Proportions: We evaluate the “golden ratio” of your facial thirds - forehead, mid-face, and lower third - to determine ideal tooth length and width proportions that are harmonious with your overall facial structure.

Lip Dynamics: Your smile is framed by your lips. We analyse how much of your upper teeth are visible at rest and at full smile, and how your lower teeth appear during speech. This guides decisions about tooth length, angle, and exposure.

Midline Alignment: The centre line between your two upper front teeth ideally aligns with the centre of your face and the tip of your nose. Even a one-millimetre midline deviation is noticeable to the trained eye - and correcting it transforms smile symmetry.

Gingival Contour: The scallop shape and height of your gum line across all visible teeth should follow a predictable, aesthetically pleasing pattern. Irregularities here - even subtle ones - disrupt the visual flow of the smile.

Tooth Proportions and Incisal Edge: The width-to-height ratio of each tooth, the shape of the incisal (biting) edge, the degree of translucency at the tips - all of these details are carefully planned and executed in every smile we design.

This level of scientific and artistic analysis is what defines Smile Designing in Kothrud at The Dental Studio. It is not just dentistry. It is precision aesthetics - and it shows in every result we deliver.

text:
Dental Care for Adults Under 40 - Smile Inn Dental Clinic
Adults Under 40
Tooth decay is commonly thought to be an issue just for children, but the truth is that we are all at risk for tooth decay at some point in our lives. Dental disorders that go untreated can lead to major health issues like infection and tooth loss. As a result, we must ensure that dental problems are addressed quickly and properly in order to address associated health issues.
The good news is that dental disorders are completely avoidable. A better method to achieve this is to practise healthy behaviours such as cleaning your teeth twice a day, flossing, eating a well-balanced diet, and avoiding fast food.
Concern for Adults Under 40
Gum Disease
Teeth Grinding
Sensitive Teeth
TMJ
Cavities
Dental Abscess
HIV/AIDS-Hepatitis B & C
Dental Extraction
Uneven/Discoloured teeth
Allergies
Adults between the ages of 25 and 40 are transitioning from carefree days of fantasy to days of responsibility and accountability. This is the age when most people begin their families, settle into employment, plan their children’s futures, and secure their financial futures.
People become incredibly careless with their health as a result of all of this additional pressure.
Particularly important is oral health.
Some people believe that tooth decay only affects youngsters, but did you realise that you are at danger for the rest of your life? Untreated dental illness can result in major health issues such infection, bone or nerve damage, and tooth loss. If left untreated, dental infections can spread to other parts of the body and, in rare situations, become life threatening.
The good news is that tooth decay can be avoided.
By adopting these healthy practises, you may perform preventative dentistry on yourself:
The IDA suggests that:
Brush your teeth twice a day, floss between your teeth once a day, eat a balanced diet, and limit snacking between meals. Also, remember to go to the dentist on a regular basis. You can reduce your risk of tooth decay by following a good dental regimen and eating nutritious foods.
Remember that your youth will not last forever, but if you take care of yourself now, ageing older will not be as bad!
For a happy and healthy smile, make an appointment with your dentist.

Privacy Policy - Smile Inn Dental Clinic
Who we are
Our website address is: https://smileinn.in.
When visitors leave comments on the site we collect the data shown in the comments form, and also the visitor’s IP address and browser user agent string to help spam detection.
An anonymized string created from your email address (also called a hash) may be provided to the Gravatar service to see if you are using it. The Gravatar service privacy policy is available here: https://automattic.com/privacy/. After approval of your comment, your profile picture is visible to the public in the context of your comment.
If you upload images to the website, you should avoid uploading images with embedded location data (EXIF GPS) included. Visitors to the website can download and extract any location data from images on the website.
Cookies
If you leave a comment on our site you may opt-in to saving your name, email address and website in cookies. These are for your convenience so that you do not have to fill in your details again when you leave another comment. These cookies will last for one year.
If you visit our login page, we will set a temporary cookie to determine if your browser accepts cookies. This cookie contains no personal data and is discarded when you close your browser.
When you log in, we will also set up several cookies to save your login information and your screen display choices. Login cookies last for two days, and screen options cookies last for a year. If you select “Remember Me”, your login will persist for two weeks. If you log out of your account, the login cookies will be removed.
If you edit or publish an article, an additional cookie will be saved in your browser. This cookie includes no personal data and simply indicates the post ID of the article you just edited. It expires after 1 day.
Embedded content from other websites
Articles on this site may include embedded content (e.g. videos, images, articles, etc.). Embedded content from other websites behaves in the exact same way as if the visitor has visited the other website.
These websites may collect data about you, use cookies, embed additional third-party tracking, and monitor your interaction with that embedded content, including tracking your interaction with the embedded content if you have an account and are logged in to that website.
If you request a password reset, your IP address will be included in the reset email.
How long we retain your data
If you leave a comment, the comment and its metadata are retained indefinitely. This is so we can recognize and approve any follow-up comments automatically instead of holding them in a moderation queue.
For users that register on our website (if any), we also store the personal information they provide in their user profile. All users can see, edit, or delete their personal information at any time (except they cannot change their username). Website administrators can also see and edit that information.
What rights you have over your data
Suggested text: If you have an account on this site, or have left comments, you can request to receive an exported file of the personal data we hold about you, including any data you have provided to us. You can also request that we erase any personal data we hold about you. This does not include any data we are obliged to keep for administrative, legal, or security purposes.
Where we send your data
Visitor comments may be checked through an automated spam detection service.

Kids Dental Treatment in Kothrud Pune
With kids, dental treatment is not the same as for adults. Kids are more prone to cavities and parents are not very sure on what is the best way to maintain their kids’ oral health. This is why getting good dental treatment is essential. 
If you reside in Pune, and want to seek dental help for your kid, then we have the perfect place for you to visit. At Smile-Inn Dental Clinic, kids receive the finest dental treatment in Pune. Want to find out more about kids’ dental treatment in Kothrud, Pune? We got you.
Dental checklist for your child’s back-to-school
Regular dental checkups are a must, for every school age child.
Regular tooth brushing prevents tooth decay and disease.
Provide your child with snacks and lunch items that are healthy and nutritious.
Make sure that your sports minded child is protected with a mouth guard, while participating in sports activities.
Advantages of getting kids dental treatment?
Coming to Smile-Inn for your kids’ dental treatment in Kothrud is a good option. We say so because of the below given advantages:
At Smile-Inn, your kid will feel at home. The ambience is not like that of a typical dental clinic, everything is very relaxing and the staff is welcoming.
To receive expert kids’ dental treatment in Kothrud, Smile-Inn is a great option because the dentists here are experts at providing treatments to kids.
At Smile-Inn Dental Clinic, your child will receive a full oral checkup on every visit, the dentists take a preventive approach of treatment as they try to prevent any future dental problems.
While there are many other clinics for kids’ dental treatment in Kothrud, Smile-Inn might just become your kids favourite within the very first visit.
Why should you look for a clinic for kids dental treatment?
Dental treatment for kids is not the same as that for adults. Kids must be handled with extra care, and extra love. As a parent, you should look for some specific features in a clinic for kids dental treatment in Kothrud.
The dental experts in the clinic should have some specific training to treat kids. Pediatric dentists are the specialists who treat dental problems in kids. You should look for dentists who have some experience with treating kids.
Choose a clinic that uses the preventive approach of kids dental treatment, this means that the dentist treats your child in a way that prompts prevention of cavities, and other dental problems.
To give the right kids dental treatment, the clinic should have a welcoming and kid-friendly environment. This is to ensure the experience does not scare the kids.
Qualified Doctors
Dr. B Srinivasan
Prosthodontist & Implantologist
Dr. Anjali Srinivasan
Esthetic Dentist
At-home oral hygiene care for kids dental treatment
Since preventive treatment is a very important part of kids dental treatment in Pune, you can also do it on your own. Here are some tips for you:
Prevent giving sugary food to your kids
Always brush twice a day with fluoride toothpaste
Floss everyday
Rise your kids’ mouth with fluoride water
Teach your kids how to do all this on their own, and help them do it as soon as their teeth start coming. You won’t need kids’ dental treatment in Pune, if you are careful on your own. 
Now you are completely ready to know where to invest your time and money to get kids dental treatment.
We hope your treatment visit is fun and healthy!
What oral treatments are offered for kids dental treatment?
To get the right kids dental treatment, look at the range of treatments offered at the clinic. At Smile-Inn, you will find each of these:
Treatment for cavities – One of the most common kids’ dental treatment is to treat cavities. 
Treatment for bad breath – The problem of bad breath can develop at any age, but it is also very common with children.
Treatment for sensitivity – Children often get sensitive teeth, always go for a clinic that offers sensitivity treatment as kids dental treatment in Pune.
Call for Appointment 
OFFER 
Frequently asked questions
A toothbrush with soft bristles and a small head, especially one designed for infants, is the best choice for infants. Brushing at least once a day, at bedtime, will remove plaque bacteria that can lead to decay.
"First visit by first birthday" is the general rule. To prevent dental problems, your child should see a pediatric dentist when the first tooth appears, usually between 6 and 12 months of age, certainly no later than his/her first birthday.
Thumb and pacifier sucking habits that go on for a long period of time can create crowded, crooked teeth or bite problems. If they are still sucking their thumbs or fingers when the permanent teeth arrive, a mouth appliance may be recommended by your pediatric dentist. Most children stop these habits on their own.
With contemporary safeguards, such as lead aprons and high-speed film, the amount of radiation received in a dental X-ray examination is extremely small. Even though there is very little risk, pediatric dentists are particularly careful to minimize the exposure of child patients to radiation. In fact, dental X-rays represent a far smaller risk than an undetected and untreated dental problem.

text:
FAQs - Smile Inn Dental Clinic
Everyone has questions about going to the dentist which is perfectly natural. So in this post about our most frequently asked dental questions you’ll find detailed answers about our dental services offered at Smile-Inn dental clinic.
Dentistry is the diagnosis, treatment, and prevention of conditions, disorders, and diseases of the teeth, gums, mouth, and jaw. Often considered necessary for complete oral health, dentistry can have an impact on the health of your entire body.
A dentist is a specialist who works to diagnose, treat, and prevent oral health problems.
If your doctor is a pediatric dentist, this means that he or she specializes in caring for children from infancy through their teen years. A pediatric dentist has received the proper education and training needed to work with young kids. Other specializations include:
Endodontics (root canals)
Oral and maxillofacial (including pathology, radiology, and surgery)
Orthodontics and dentofacial orthopedics
Periodontics (gum disease)
Prosthodontics (implants)
Visiting the dentist regularly will not only help keep your teeth and mouth healthy, but will also help keep the rest of your body healthy. Dental care is important because it:
Helps prevent tooth decay
Protects against periodontal (gum) disease, which can lead to tooth and bone loss
Prevents bad breath – brushing, flossing, and seeing the dentist regularly will help reduce the amount of bacteria in your mouth that causes bad breath
Gives you a more attractive smile and increases your self-confidence
Helps keep teeth looking bright by preventing them from becoming stained by food, drinks, and tobacco
Strengthens your teeth so that you can enjoy healthy, beautiful smiles for the rest of your life!
Your teeth may feel fine, but it’s still important to see the dentist regularly because problems can exist without you knowing. Your smile’s appearance is important, and your dentist can help keep your smile healthy and looking beautiful. With so many advances in dentistry, you no longer have to settle for stained, chipped, missing, or misshapen teeth. Today’s dentists offer many treatment choices that can help you smile with confidence, including:
Professional teeth whitening
Fillings that mimic the appearance of natural teeth
Tooth replacement and full smile makeovers
Choosing a dentist who “clicks” with you and your family is important, and you may wish to consider several dentists before making your final decision. During your first visit, you should be able to determine whether the dentist is right for you. During your appointment, consider the following:
Is the appointment schedule convenient?
Is the office easy to get to and close by?
Does the office appear to be clean and orderly?
Was your medical and dental history recorded and placed in a permanent file?
Does the dentist explain techniques for good oral health?
Is information about cost presented to you before treatment is scheduled?
Professional teeth whitening
Fillings that mimic the appearance of natural teeth
Tooth replacement and full smile makeovers
ALWAYS remember to brush your teeth at least two times a day, and floss at least once!
Make sure to use toothpaste that contains fluoride, and ask your dentist if you need a fluoride rinse. This will help prevent cavities.
Avoid foods with a lot of sugar (sugar increases the amount of bacteria that grows in your mouth causing more plaque and possibly cavities) and avoid tobacco (this can stain your teeth, cause gum disease, and eventually lead to oral cancer).
Don’t be afraid to brush your tongue! By brushing your tongue, you will remove food particles and reduce the amount of plaque-causing bacteria. Tongue brushing also helps keep your breath fresh.
Be sure to schedule your routine checkup. It is recommended that you visit the dentist every six months.

Is the office easy to get to and close by?
Does the office appear to be clean and orderly?
Was your medical and dental history recorded and placed in a permanent file?
Does the dentist explain techniques for good oral health?

Professional teeth whitening

The American Academy of Pediatric Dentistry (AAPD) recommends that children first see a dentist as early as six months of age and no later than one year of age. text:
How to Maintain Your Smile After Cosmetic Dentistry
A radiant, confident smile doesn’t stop the moment you leave the dental chair - it’s just the beginning. Whether you’ve had veneers, teeth whitening, dental bonding, or a full smile makeover, the results you’re so proud of depend heavily on how well you care for them afterward. Many patients invest time and money into cosmetic dental treatments, only to see the results fade because of poor aftercare habits.
If you’ve recently undergone a cosmetic procedure, or you’re planning one soon, this guide will walk you through everything you need to know about maintaining that picture-perfect smile for years to come.
Why Aftercare Matters So Much
Cosmetic dentistry is an investment - not just financially, but in your confidence and quality of life. Treatments like veneers, crowns, and whitening are designed to be durable, but they’re not indestructible. Factors like diet, oral hygiene habits, lifestyle choices, and regular dental visits all play a role in how long your results last.
Neglecting aftercare can lead to staining, chipping, gum irritation, or even the need for early replacement of dental work. On the other hand, a little discipline in your daily routine can help your smile stay bright and healthy for a decade or more.
1. Stick to a Gentle but Consistent Oral Hygiene Routine
Immediately after treatment, your teeth and gums may be slightly sensitive, so it’s important to be gentle yet consistent.
Use a soft-bristled toothbrush to avoid scratching veneers or bonding material.
Brush twice daily with a non-abrasive, fluoride toothpaste.
Floss daily to prevent plaque buildup around crowns, veneers, or implants.
Consider using an alcohol-free mouthwash to avoid irritating sensitive gums.
Sticking to this simple routine every single day is one of the most effective ways to protect your investment and prevent premature wear.
2. Watch What You Eat and Drink
Diet plays a bigger role in smile maintenance than most people realize. Certain foods and drinks can stain or damage cosmetic dental work over time.
Foods and drinks to limit:
Coffee, tea, and red wine (common staining culprits)
Dark sauces like soy sauce or curry
Hard foods such as ice, hard candy, or nuts that can chip veneers
Sticky foods like caramel that can pull at bonding material
Better choices:
Crunchy fruits and vegetables like apples and carrots
Dairy products, which help neutralize acids
Plenty of water to rinse away food particles naturally
If you do indulge in staining foods or drinks, rinsing your mouth with water afterward can help minimize their impact.
3. Avoid Harmful Habits
Certain habits can quietly undo the results of even the best cosmetic dental treatment. Nail-biting, chewing on pens, using your teeth to open packages, and grinding your teeth at night can all cause chips, cracks, or premature wear.
If you grind your teeth (a condition called bruxism), your dentist may recommend a custom night guard to protect your investment while you sleep. Smoking is another habit worth reconsidering - not only does it stain teeth, but it also increases the risk of gum disease, which can compromise the longevity of cosmetic work.
4. Don’t Skip Regular Dental Checkups
Even with excellent at-home care, professional maintenance is essential. Regular visits allow your dentist to catch small issues - like minor chips or early staining - before they become bigger problems.
Choosing the right dental partner makes a real difference here. Patients often search for the Best Dentist in Kothrud when they want ongoing, reliable care after a cosmetic procedure, since consistent monitoring by the same dentist ensures better long-term outcomes and personalized attention to your specific treatment.
Most dentists recommend a checkup and professional cleaning every six months, though your dentist may suggest more frequent visits depending on your treatment type.
5. Protect Your Smile During Physical Activity
If you play contact sports or engage in activities with a risk of facial injury, a custom mouthguard is a small investment that can save your smile from serious damage. This is especially important if you’ve had veneers or crowns, as these restorations, while strong, are not entirely immune to impact.
6. Manage Sensitivity the Right Way
Some sensitivity after cosmetic treatment, especially whitening, is normal and usually temporary. However, if sensitivity persists or worsens, it’s worth discussing with your dentist rather than ignoring it.
Using toothpaste designed for sensitive teeth, avoiding extremely hot or cold foods for a few days, and following your dentist’s specific aftercare instructions can help manage discomfort effectively during the initial healing period.
7. Choose the Right Dental Partner for Long-Term Care
Your relationship with your dentist doesn’t end once your treatment is complete. In fact, ongoing care is what determines how long your results truly last. Working with an experienced Cosmetic Dentist in Kothrud ensures that any adjustments, touch-ups, or concerns are handled by someone who already understands your dental history and treatment goals.
At Tooth and Co Dental Clinic, patients receive comprehensive follow-up care designed to protect and prolong the results of their cosmetic procedures. From personalized hygiene guidance to scheduled maintenance visits, the goal is always to help you enjoy your smile with confidence, long after you’ve left the clinic.
Led by Dr. Saloni Bavalekar, the clinic focuses on patient education just as much as treatment - because a beautiful smile is only as good as the care that sustains it.
8. Know When to Seek Professional Help
Certain warning signs should never be ignored. Contact your dentist promptly if you notice:
Sharp or persistent pain
Visible chips, cracks, or gaps around dental work
Sudden increase in sensitivity
Loose crowns, veneers, or bonding material
Unusual discoloration in a specific area
Catching these issues early often means simpler, less expensive fixes compared to waiting until the problem worsens.
Frequently Asked Questions
Q1: How long does cosmetic dental work typically last?
Depending on the treatment, results can last anywhere from a few years (whitening) to 10–15 years or more (veneers and crowns), provided proper care is maintained.
Q2: Can I drink coffee after getting veneers?
Yes, but in moderation. Veneers are more stain-resistant than natural teeth, but excessive coffee or tea consumption can still dull their shine over time.
Q3: Is teeth whitening safe to repeat?
Yes, occasional touch-up whitening is generally safe when done under professional supervision, but it should not be overused, as excessive whitening can increase sensitivity.
Q4: What’s the best way to find reliable aftercare support?
Look for a Dental Clinic in Kothrud that offers structured follow-up visits and is transparent about long-term maintenance plans, not just the initial procedure.
Q5: Do I need special dental products after cosmetic treatment?
Not always, but non-abrasive toothpaste and a soft-bristled brush are generally recommended to protect veneers, bonding, and whitened enamel.
Q6: How soon after treatment can I return to a normal diet?
This varies by procedure. Your dentist will provide specific guidelines, but most patients can gradually return to normal eating within a few days.
Final Thoughts: Your Smile Deserves Long-Term Care
Cosmetic dentistry can transform not just how you look, but how you feel about yourself. But that transformation is only as lasting as the care you put into it afterward. Simple daily habits, mindful eating, and regular professional checkups go a long way in preserving your results for years.
If you’re looking for expert guidance on maintaining your smile - or you’re considering a Cosmetic Dental Treatment in Kothrud - the team is here to help you every step of the way, from your first consultation to years of follow-up care.

**Q3: Is teeth whitening safe to repeat?**

Yes, occasional touch-up whitening is generally safe when done under professional supervision, but it should not be overused, as excessive whitening can increase sensitivity.

**Q5: Do I need special dental products after cosmetic treatment?**

Not always, but non-abrasive toothpaste and a soft-bristled brush are generally recommended to protect veneers, bonding, and whitened enamel.

**Q6: How soon after treatment can I return to a normal diet?**

This varies by procedure. Your dentist will provide specific guidelines, but most patients can gradually return to normal eating within a few days.
