Same-Day Dental Implants in Pune: Cost, Candidacy, and What to Expect
Introduction
Few dental transformations compare to the psychological and physical shift of walking out of a clinic with functional, fixed teeth in a single visit. The sheer appeal of skipping months of waiting with a gap or a loose temporary denture is what drives the rising popularity of same-day implants.
However, that immediate gratification naturally brings up two crucial questions for every patient: Is this procedure actually suitable for my jaw, and what is it going to cost me?
This comprehensive guide is designed to give you clear, unclouded answers. We will break down exactly what same-day implants are, who qualifies for them, what you can expect from the treatment timeline, and provide a realistic look at the current 2026 investment costs in Pune.
Hello, I am Dr. Rohan Deshpande. I hold an MDS in Prosthodontics and Crown and Bridge, and practice as an Implantologist at Orion Dental Specialities in Kothrud. My specialization focuses precisely on this type of advanced oral rehabilitation-restoring missing structures with highly precise, fixed digital prosthetics so patients can chew, speak, and smile naturally.
What Are Same-Day (Immediate-Loading) Implants?
Same-day implants, also called immediate-loading implants, let you get a new tooth in just one visit.
In a traditional implant procedure, you have to wait several months for the bone to heal before getting a tooth. With the same-day method, the dentist places the titanium post and attaches a temporary, fixed tooth on the exact same day. You walk out with a complete smile right away.
Later, after your jaw fully heals, this temporary tooth is swapped for a stronger, permanent one. Keep in mind, this requires strong jawbone density, so it is not suitable for everyone.
Same-Day vs Traditional Implants: What Is the Difference?
When choosing between traditional and same-day dental implants, the long-term result is actually exactly the same. Both options use the same high-quality titanium post that acts as a new root for your tooth. The real difference lies in the timeline and who qualifies for each treatment.
Traditional Implants
With the traditional method, the dentist places the implant and lets it heal for three to six months. During this time, your jawbone naturally fuses around the post to lock it securely in place. Only after this deep healing is the final tooth attached. Because it allows for plenty of healing time, this safe, step-by-step approach suits almost everyone-even if your bone density is less than perfect.
Same-Day Implants
With same-day implants, you get a temporary tooth attached immediately on the day of surgery. You walk out with a complete smile right away. However, your jawbone must be exceptionally healthy, thick, and strong from the very start to tightly grip the implant without moving.
If you have great bone stability, same-day implants offer fantastic speed. If your bone needs extra time and support, the traditional route remains the safest road to a lifetime smile.
How Much Do Same-Day Implants Cost in Pune? (The Quick Answer)
Give a short summary for readers who just want the numbers. Explain that the cost depends on the implant system, the crown material, how many teeth are replaced, and whether any bone work is needed. Then insert the price table below.
Option	Representative 2026 Pune Range	Notes	
Single same-day implant (implant + crown)	30,000 to 60,000	Varies by implant system and crown material	
Single implant, premium European system (e.g., Straumann)	35000 to 60000	Higher-research system, longer track record	
Full arch same-day, All-on-4 (per arch)	2,00,000 to 5,00,000	Fixed full-arch teeth supported on 4 implants	
Full arch same-day, All-on-6 (per arch)	2,50,000 to 6,00,000	More implants for more support	
Note: these are representative 2026 Pune ranges for guidance only. Please do not quote exact Orion fees here. Direct cost questions to a consultation.
Are You a Candidate for Same-Day Implants?
Same-day implants are wonderful for the right case, but they are not for everyone. For this procedure to work, you need enough healthy jawbone to hold the implant firmly in place right away. You also need healthy gums and good overall health.
If you have significant bone loss, uncontrolled diabetes, or are a heavy smoker, healing is much harder. In those cases, a safer, staged approach is best.
Every mouth is unique. Only a thorough examination and a 3D scan can safely decide if same-day implants are the right choice for your smile.
What the Same-Day Implant Process Looks Like
Walk the reader through the visit calmly. Cover the points below in your own words.
A CBCT scan and digital planning to check bone and plan the implant position.
Placing the implant under local anaesthesia, comfortably.
Fitting a temporary fixed tooth or teeth the same day in suitable cases.
A healing period before the permanent crown or bridge is fitted.
What Decides Your Same-Day Implant Cost
Short intro line, then a bullet list in your own voice.
Number of teeth replaced. A single tooth costs far less than a full arch.
Implant system chosen. Brazilian systems are a sound, accessible option; European systems such as Straumann sit higher for their longer research record.
Crown or bridge material. The final restoration material affects the price.
Bone grafting if needed. Some cases need bone support first, which adds to the cost and the timeline.
Full-arch design. All-on-4 and All-on-6 differ in the number of implants and the cost.
What Is Included at Orion
A proper same-day dental implant package is designed to be comprehensive, ensuring there are no surprises midway through your treatment. When reviewing a quote, a standard inclusive package should transparently cover:
Initial Planning: Your clinical examinations and necessary 3D CBCT scans.
The Surgery: The premium titanium implant post and its precise placement.
Immediate Smile: The fabrication and fitting of your temporary fixed tooth.
Follow-ups: All essential post-operative review and healing check-up visits.
Crucially, the package must explicitly state the cost of the final permanent crown or bridge that replaces the temporary one a few months later. Because different clinics structure fees differently, I always encourage patients to ask exactly what is and is not included before comparing generic quotes.
To keep things completely clear and upfront, basic single-tooth implant treatments at Orion Dental Specialities ranges from 35,000 to 60,000. Knowing exactly what your package entails ensures you can plan your financial investment with total peace of mind.
Aftercare and How Long They Last
Setting honest expectations is the best way to ensure your new smile lasts. Even though your temporary teeth look and feel great right away, they need a little extra care at first. You will need to stick to a softer diet for the first few months. This keeps the new tooth safe from heavy chewing while your jawbone gently heals and locks the implant into place.
Looking after your investment is simple but vital. Brushing well every day and coming in for quick check-ups will keep your gums healthy. With good daily care, your implant can easily last 25 to 30 years.
Payment Options and EMI
Because same-day implant treatment is naturally split into different phases, the investment is also spread out over time. This built-in timeline makes managing the financial aspect much more comfortable and predictable for you.
When you choose this treatment, your payment is divided into two straightforward stages:
The First Installment: This covers your initial digital planning, the surgical placement of the implant, and your immediate temporary tooth.
The Second Installment: This is paid a few months later, only when your jaw has fully healed and we are ready to design and fit your final permanent crown.
At Orion Dental Specialities, we also offer direct clinic installment plans to help you step into your new smile with total peace of mind. Every smile is different, so we invite you to talk to us about these flexible options during your consultation.
Frequently Asked Questions
Use a question and answer format. Each answer around 40 to 70 words, in your clinic voice. Please keep the exact question text and adjust the answers as you wish.
Q: Can everyone get same-day dental implants?
Answer prompt: no. Same-day implants need enough healthy bone and good gum health for the implant to be stable immediately. Many people are suitable, but some are safer with a staged approach. A scan and examination give the honest answer for your case.
Q: How much do same-day implants cost in Pune?
Answer prompt: a single same-day implant with a crown generally ranges from around 30,000 to 60,000 depending on the system and crown, while a full arch is much higher. An examination and scan give the accurate figure for your case.
Q: Is the procedure comfortable?
Answer prompt: yes. The implant is placed under local anaesthesia and most patients are comfortable during and after the visit. Mild soreness for a few days is normal and settles with simple pain relief and the aftercare we explain.
Conclusion
To wrap things up, here are the most important takeaways as you consider your options:
Fixed Teeth in a Single Visit: For the right clinical case, same-day implants are a wonderful way to walk out with a complete smile immediately.
Tailored Cost: The final investment depends entirely on the specific implant system chosen and how many teeth need to be replaced.
The Crucial First Step: Only a comprehensive examination and a 3D scan can safely confirm if your jawbone and overall health are ready for immediate loading.
Choosing to restore your smile is a significant step, and you deserve to have all the right information tailored to your unique mouth. If you would like to explore what is possible for you, we warmly invite you to book a friendly, detailed consultation with us at Orion Dental Specialities. We are here to help you guide your health journey at your own comfortable pace.

Root Canal Treatment Cost in Pune (2026): What You Will Pay and Why
If you just found out you need a root canal-a routine procedure where a dentist removes infected pulp from inside a damaged tooth to save it from extraction-your first thoughts are likely: “Will it hurt?” and “How much is this going to cost?” Let’s clear up the biggest myth right away. Thanks to modern dental technology and advanced local anesthetics, getting a root canal today is virtually painless, feeling no different than receiving a standard cavity filling. As for the financial side, this guide outlines exactly what a root canal costs in Pune in 2026, what factors influence that price, and what is included in your care.
I am Dr. Rohan Deshpande, MDS in Prosthodontics and Crown and Bridge, practicing at Orion Dental Specialities in Kothrud. Our clinic believes that transparent pricing is just as vital to your peace of mind as providing high-quality, comfortable clinical care. In Pune, the base cost for the procedure typically ranges from ₹2,500 to ₹8,000. However, the exact investment depends heavily on which tooth needs treatment and the specific technology used. Let’s look closer at what determines these costs so you can plan your visit with absolute confidence.
What Is a Root Canal, and Why Might You Need One?
Inside your tooth is a soft tissue called pulp that contains nerves and blood vessels. When deep decay or injury allows bacteria to enter, this pulp becomes inflamed or infected. A root canal treatment simply removes this damaged tissue, thoroughly cleans and disinfects the spaces inside, and seals them to prevent future issues.
Instead of pulling the tooth, this procedure saves your natural smile. You might need one if you experience common warning signs like a persistent, deep toothache, pain when chewing, prolonged sensitivity to hot or cold drinks, swollen gums, or a tooth that begins to look dark and discolored.
How Much Does a Root Canal Cost in Pune? (The Quick Answer)
Treatment	Representative 2026 Pune Range	Notes	
Front tooth (incisor or canine, 1 to 2 canals)	3,000 to 4,000	Fewer canals, usually simpler	
Premolar (2 canals)	4000 to 4500	Moderate complexity	
Molar (3 to 4 canals)	5,000 to 6,000	Most canals, most complex	
Single-sitting root canal	4,000 to 5,000	Completed in one visit with rotary or advanced tools	
Re-treatment of a failed root canal	8,000 to 10,000	More complex than a first-time treatment	
Root canal plus crown (together)	12,000 to 20,000	Depends on crown material: metal, ceramic, or zirconia	
Note: these are representative 2026 Pune ranges for guidance only. Please do not quote exact Orion fees here. Direct cost questions to a consultation.
What Your Root Canal Price Includes
A standard root canal treatment is a highly systematic procedure designed to eliminate infection while saving your natural tooth. When performed at a modern clinic, the process is broken down into the following clinical steps:
1. Diagnostics & Numbing
Before any work begins, the dentist takes digital X-rays to map the shape of your root canals and see the extent of the infection in the surrounding bone. Next, a local anesthetic is administered. This completely numbs the tooth and surrounding tissue, ensuring you feel nothing more than mild pressure during the procedure.
2. Setting Up Isolation
Once the tooth is entirely numb, the dentist places a dental dam (a small, protective rubber sheet) over the area. This isolates the specific tooth being treated, keeping it completely dry, sterile, and free of saliva, while preventing any dental debris or rinsing solutions from entering your throat.
3. Creating Access
Using specialized, high-precision tools, the dentist creates a small access opening through the top (or crown) of your tooth. This exposes the inner pulp chamber where the damaged nerves and blood vessels reside.
4. Cleaning & Shaping the Canals
Using ultra-fine, flexible instruments called endodontic files, the dentist carefully removes the infected or dead pulp tissue from inside the pulp chamber and down the narrow root canals. The canals are then gently widened and shaped so they can be easily filled later.
5. Thorough Disinfection
Throughout the cleaning process, the interior of the tooth is heavily flushed with antimicrobial rinsing solutions. This step is critical; it washes away microscopic debris and completely disinfects the root system to eliminate any remaining bacteria.
6. Filling & Sealing the Roots
Once the canals are clean and dry, they are filled with a biocompatible, rubber-like material called gutta-percha. Combined with a medical-grade sealer cement, this material is packed tightly into the empty canals to create a hermetic, airtight seal that blocks future bacteria from entering.
7. The Temporary Filling
To close the initial access opening on top of the tooth, a temporary filling is placed. This protects the inside of your tooth from food particles and bacteria while the area settles over the next few weeks.
What Decides Your Root Canal Cost
Short intro line, then a bullet list in your own voice.
Which tooth it is. Front teeth have fewer canals and cost less. Molars have three or four canals and take longer.
Number of canals and complexity. Curved or narrow canals take more skill and time.
Infection severity. A badly infected tooth may need extra visits or medication.
First-time treatment or re-treatment. Redoing a failed root canal is more complex and costs more.
Technology used. Rotary instruments and magnification can change the cost.
The crown afterwards. Most back teeth need a crown after a root canal, which is a separate cost.
Single-Sitting vs Multi-Visit Root Canal
The choice between a single-sitting and multi-visit root canal is purely clinical, not just a matter of convenience.
A single-sitting treatment is highly efficient, completing the cleaning, disinfecting, and sealing in one single appointment. This approach works beautifully for straightforward cases where the infection hasn’t spread deep into the bone.
However, if a tooth has a severe abscess or long-standing infection, it is safer to split the procedure over two visits. During a multi-visit treatment, your dentist places a protective medication inside the canals to actively fight the bacteria for a week before finishing the final seal. Your dentist will advise which path ensures the longest life for your tooth.
Do You Need a Crown After a Root Canal?
Once a root canal removes the infected internal pulp, the tooth loses its natural blood supply and hydration. Over time, this treated tooth-especially a heavy-chewing back molar-becomes brittle and highly susceptible to cracking under everyday biting pressure.
To protect it, a dental crown (or cap) is usually necessary to completely encase and reinforce the structure. Please note that the crown is a separate cost from the root canal procedure itself; however, skipping it risks fracturing the tooth, which could lead to an unavoidable extraction later.
Does a Root Canal Hurt?
With modern anaesthesia, the treatment itself is usually comfortable and similar to having a filling. Mild soreness for a day or two afterwards is normal and settles with simple pain relief. Please avoid the word painless. Use comfortable or virtually pain free instead.
What Happens If You Delay Treatment
Putting off a root canal might temporarily avoid the dental chair, but internal infections do not heal on their own. Over time, bacteria will travel down the roots and into the surrounding jawbone, creating a painful, swollen pocket called an abscess.
Eventually, the tooth structure degrades so severely that a root canal is no longer an option, leaving extraction as the only choice. Factual reality shows that losing a tooth is always more expensive; replacing it later with a dental bridge or implant requires significantly more time, multiple surgical steps, and far higher financial costs than saving your natural tooth today.
Payment Options
Fee of the root canal treatment can be paid in two equal installments.
Frequently Asked Questions
Use a question and answer format. Each answer around 40 to 70 words, in your clinic voice. Please keep the exact question text and adjust the answers as you wish.

It depends on the tooth. A front tooth with one or two canals costs less than a molar with three or four. Most root canals in Pune fall between 4,000 and 12,000, and a crown afterwards is a separate cost. An examination gives the accurate figure.
Q: Is a single-sitting root canal safe?
yes, for many cases. A single-sitting root canal is completed in one visit and works well for straightforward teeth. Heavily infected teeth are sometimes safer over two visits. Your dentist will advise what is best for your tooth.
Q: Do I really need a crown after a root canal?
Usually yes, especially for back teeth. A treated tooth becomes more brittle and a crown protects it from cracking. Skipping the crown is a common reason treated teeth fail later. We will tell you honestly if your tooth needs one.
Q: Does a root canal hurt?
With modern anaesthesia the treatment is usually comfortable, much like a filling. Some mild soreness for a day or two afterwards is normal and settles with simple pain relief. The procedure relieves the pain caused by the infection.
Conclusion
Ultimately, navigating a root canal comes down to three simple realities: total treatment costs in Pune generally range from ₹2,500 to ₹8,000 based on the specific tooth; the final price depends on clinical factors like infection severity and advanced tech; and a separate dental crown is almost always necessary to protect your investment long-term.
If you are dealing with a troubled tooth, the best way to get absolute clarity on your treatment plan and an exact, personalized quote is to let a professional take a look. text:
Smile Makeover & Veneers in Pune: Costs and Options
By Dr. Rohan Deshpande, Prosthodontist and Implant Dentist, Orion Dental Specialities, Kothrud, Pune.
A smile makeover is a customised cosmetic dentistry process designed to enhance the appearance of your smile through one or more procedures. Whether you are addressing chipped, stained, misaligned, or missing teeth, treatments like porcelain veneers, dental crowns, teeth whitening, and implants are carefully tailored to your facial structure.
Beyond boosting aesthetic confidence, these personalised plans often improve overall oral health and function. By combining art and advanced dental science, a smile makeover delivers a natural-looking result that refreshes your appearance and helps you share your smile with confidence.
I am Dr. Rohan Deshpande. I completed my graduation at Sinhgad Dental College, Pune, and my master’s degree in Prosthodontics and Implant Dentistry at A B Shetty Memorial Institute of Dental Sciences, Mangalore, with a special focus on smile makeover procedures. I have more than 10 years of experience in aesthetic dentistry and smile makeovers, and I practise at Orion Dental Specialities in Kothrud, Pune.
What Is a Smile Makeover?
A smile makeover is a comprehensive cosmetic dental treatment designed to improve the appearance of your smile. It is a customised process that combines multiple dental procedures to address your specific aesthetic goals.
Unlike a single treatment, a smile makeover considers your entire facial appearance, including your skin tone, hair colour, lip line, and gum tissue. Dentists use a variety of treatments to achieve the change:
Porcelain veneers to hide chips, gaps, or deep stains.
Teeth whitening to lift stains and brighten your enamel.
Dental crowns to cover heavily damaged or decayed teeth.
Invisalign or clear aligners to fix crowding and spacing issues.
Composite bonding to quickly repair minor structural flaws.
Gum contouring to reshape an uneven or gummy smile.
The process begins with a detailed consultation to assess your oral health. Your dentist then creates a personalised plan, using digital imaging to show your predicted results. Beyond enhancing your appearance, a smile makeover can restore dental function, improve chewing, and boost your self-confidence. It changes not just your teeth, but your whole facial aesthetic.
Most makeovers combine two or three of the treatments below, rather than all of them. The table gives representative 2026 Pune ranges so you have a realistic sense of the figures before you visit. Your own plan depends on the treatments you actually need.
Treatment	Representative 2026 Pune Range	What It Addresses	
Porcelain veneers	8,000 to 15,000 per tooth	Chips, gaps, shape, and stubborn colour	
Composite bonding	3,000 to 5,000 per tooth	Minor chips and small gaps	
Teeth whitening	8,000 to 20,000	General staining and discolouration	
Crowns	6,000 to 15,000 per tooth	Broken, worn, or heavily filled teeth	
Clear aligners or braces	80,000 to 3,50,000	Crooked or crowded teeth, corrected before cosmetic work	
Gum reshaping	5,000 to 10,000	An uneven gum line or a gummy smile	
Note: These are representative 2026 Pune ranges for guidance only. They are not Orion’s fixed fees. For your exact plan, book a consultation.
Veneers in Focus: Porcelain vs Composite
When choosing between porcelain and composite veneers, the right choice depends on your budget, timeline, and aesthetic goals.
Porcelain Veneers
Porcelain veneers are thin shells of medical-grade ceramic bonded to the front of the teeth.
Appearance. High translucency creates a natural, lifelike look.
Durability. A hard-wearing material that resists chipping and lasts 10 to 15 years.
Stain resistance. Highly resistant to coffee, tea, smoke, and dark foods.
Process. Requires two to three appointments and some permanent enamel removal.
Composite Veneers
Composite veneers use a tooth-coloured engineered resin applied directly to the teeth.
Appearance. Good aesthetics, though it lacks porcelain’s realistic light reflection.
Durability. A softer material that is more prone to chipping and lasts 5 to 7 years.
Stain resistance. Absorbs stains over time and needs regular polishing.
Process. Completed in a single visit with minimal or no enamel removal.
Key Comparison
Feature	Porcelain Veneers	Composite Veneers	
Longevity	10 to 15 years	5 to 7 years	
Reversibility	No (enamel is removed)	Yes (minimal prep)	
Cost	Higher upfront investment	Lower initial cost	
Repairability	Must be replaced if broken	Easily patched in-office	
See Your New Smile Before You Start
The ‘see your new smile before you start’ workflow relies on Digital Smile Design (DSD). This technology lets you preview and approve your results before any dental work begins. Here is how the step-by-step workflow operates.
1. Data collection
Your dentist gathers high-resolution digital media of your face and teeth.
Studio photography. Captures your smile from multiple angles and facial expressions.
Video clips. Records how your teeth look while you speak and laugh naturally.
Intraoral scanning. Creates a 3D digital model of your teeth without messy moulds.
2. Digital design
The dentist uses specialised software to plan your ideal smile proportions.
Facial analysis. Aligns your new teeth with your eyes, lips, and facial midline.
Teeth customisation. Adjusts the digital shape, height, width, and colour of each tooth.
Cross-disciplinary planning. Combines cosmetic design with structural and functional biology.
3. The physical mock-up (the test drive)
You get to try on your new smile in real life before making a commitment.
3D printing. The digital design is printed into a physical 3D model.
Temporary matrix. A custom tray transfers temporary tooth-coloured resin over your real teeth.
Live preview. You can look in the mirror, talk, and take photos with your trial smile.
4. Approval and execution
Once you approve the temporary look, the final transformation begins.
Replication. The approved mock-up serves as the exact blueprint for the lab.
Fabrication. Technicians create your permanent porcelain veneers or crowns to match.
Delivery. The dentist bonds the final restorations, matching your preview.
What Decides Your Smile Makeover Cost
Your smile makeover cost depends on three primary factors: treatment complexity, material selection, and professional expertise.
Treatment complexity. The number of teeth involved and the extent of correction required directly affect the price. Combining multiple procedures, like pairing clear aligners with gum contouring, increases the overall cost.
Material selection. High-grade, durable materials like porcelain veneers carry a higher upfront price than direct composite resin bonding.
Professional expertise. Skilled cosmetic dentists and quality dental laboratories charge more for their artistry, digital simulation technology, and the time each case takes.
How Long Does a Smile Makeover Take, and How Long Does It Last?
The timeline: how long it takes
A smile makeover timeline depends entirely on the procedures you choose.
Express makeovers (1 to 2 visits). Treatments like teeth whitening, composite bonding, and gum contouring deliver results within a few days.
Moderate makeovers (3 to 6 weeks). Procedures that need lab fabrication, such as porcelain veneers, crowns, and bridges, take a few weeks to design, preview, and bond.
Extended makeovers (6 to 24 months). If your plan needs orthodontic alignment (like Invisalign) or dental implants to replace missing teeth, the process moves in phases over several months.
The lifespan: how long it lasts
Your new smile is an investment, and different materials offer different lifespans.
Composite bonding. Typically lasts 3 to 7 years before the resin stains or chips and needs refreshing.
Porcelain veneers and crowns. Durable ceramic options regularly last 10 to 15 years, and often longer with good care.
Teeth whitening. Usually needs a touch-up every 6 to 12 months, depending on your diet.
Factors that cut lifespan short
Your daily habits directly affect how long your results last.
Bruxism (teeth grinding). Unconscious grinding or clenching can crack porcelain and chip composite resin. A protective nightguard is important.
Oral hygiene. Veneers and crowns cannot decay, but the natural tooth underneath them can still get cavities if you skip brushing and flossing.
Dietary choices. Biting into hard foods like ice or hard candy can dislodge restorations, while frequent coffee, tea, or smoking will stain composite materials.
Is a Smile Makeover Worth It?
Yes. A properly planned makeover can make a real difference to your confidence and works well on healthy teeth. That said, avoid cheap, rushed work. Poorly fitted restorations can cause serious and costly dental damage later, so careful planning matters as much as the treatment itself.
Payment Options and EMI
A smile makeover is a significant investment, but the cost can be managed flexibly.
Staged care. Break your treatment into clinical phases to spread the expense over time.
EMI options. Monthly instalment plans can make treatment easier to budget for.
In-house plans. Divide payments between your initial preparation visit and your final fitting.
At Orion Dental Specialities, we plan makeovers in stages and offer direct clinic instalment plans. Talk to us during your consultation to find a plan that works for you.
How to Get Your Personalised Smile Plan
No honest quote is possible without seeing your teeth, because every makeover is different. Here is what happens at a consultation at Orion Dental Specialities.
A full check of your teeth, gums, and bite.
A digital scan and a smile simulation so you can see the possible result.
A discussion of the treatment options that suit your goals and budget.
A clear, itemised plan with stages and costs.
Frequently Asked Questions
How much does a full smile makeover cost in Pune?
The cost of a full smile makeover depends on several factors. As a guide, a full set of composite veneers ranges from around 20,000 to 45,000, while a full set of ceramic veneers ranges from around 60,000 to 1,20,000. An examination and a personalised plan give you the accurate figure for your case.
Do veneers damage your natural teeth?
Properly planned veneers remove only a very thin layer of enamel, and some conservative options remove almost none. The key is careful planning and a skilled hand. We always aim to keep as much healthy tooth as possible.
How long do veneers last?
Porcelain veneers can last many years with good care, while composite bonding usually lasts a few years before it needs a refresh. Avoiding habits like biting nails or grinding, and keeping up good oral hygiene, helps them last longer.
Can I see my new smile before treatment starts?
Yes. At Orion we use a digital scan and a smile simulation so you can preview the likely result before committing to anything. This helps you make an informed, confident decision.
Can a smile makeover be done on EMI?
Often yes. Makeovers are usually staged, which helps spread the cost, and we offer direct clinic instalment plans. We can discuss what works for you during your consultation.
Conclusion
A smile makeover is a transformative investment in both your oral health and your self-confidence. By combining restorative and cosmetic procedures, such as teeth whitening, composite veneers, and ceramic veneers, it provides long-lasting results that enhance facial aesthetics and support overall well-being.
If you would like a plan built around your own teeth and goals, book a consultation at Orion Dental Specialities in Kothrud. I will examine your teeth, talk you through the options, and give you a clear, itemised plan with no pressure.
Medical disclaimer: All price ranges on this page are representative 2026 Pune figures based on market observation and are for guidance only. They are not Orion Dental Specialities’ fixed fees. Actual treatment costs are determined only after a full clinical examination and individualised treatment planning.
About the author: Dr. Rohan Deshpande completed his graduation at Sinhgad Dental College, Pune, and his master’s degree in Prosthodontics and Implant Dentistry at A B Shetty Memorial Institute of Dental Sciences, Mangalore. He has more than 10 years of experience in aesthetic dentistry and smile makeovers, and co-founded Orion Dental Specialities in Kothrud, Pune.

# Smile Makeover & Veneers in Pune: Costs and Options

_By Dr. Rohan Deshpande, Prosthodontist and Implant Dentist, Orion Dental Specialities, Kothrud, Pune._

A smile makeover is a customised [cosmetic dentistry](https://oriondentalspecialities.com/what-is-cosmetic-dentistry/) process designed to enhance the appearance of your smile through one or more procedures. Whether you are addressing chipped, stained, misaligned, or missing teeth, treatments like porcelain veneers, dental crowns, teeth whitening, and implants are carefully tailored to your facial structure.

Beyond boosting aesthetic confidence, these personalised plans often improve overall oral health and function. By combining art and advanced dental science, a smile makeover delivers a natural-looking result that refreshes your appearance and helps you share your smile with confidence.

I am Dr. Rohan Deshpande. I completed my graduation at Sinhgad Dental College, Pune, and my master’s degree in Prosthodontics and Implant Dentistry at A B Shetty Memorial Institute of Dental Sciences, Mangalore, with a special focus on smile makeover procedures. I have more than 10 years of experience in aesthetic dentistry and smile makeovers, and I practise at [Orion Dental Specialities](https://oriondentalspecialities.com/contact/) in Kothrud, Pune.

## What Is a Smile Makeover?

A [smile makeover](https://oriondentalspecialities.com/services/smile-makeover/) is a comprehensive cosmetic dental treatment designed to improve the appearance of your smile. It is a customised process that combines multiple dental procedures to address your specific aesthetic goals.

Unlike a single treatment, a smile makeover considers your entire facial appearance, including your skin tone, hair colour, lip line, and gum tissue. Dentists use a variety of treatments to achieve the change:

*   Porcelain veneers to hide chips, gaps, or deep stains.
*   Teeth whitening to lift stains and brighten your enamel.
*   Dental crowns to cover heavily damaged or decayed teeth.
*   Invisalign or clear aligners to fix crowding and spacing issues.
*   Composite bonding to quickly repair minor structural flaws.
*   Gum contouring to reshape an uneven or gummy smile.

The process begins with a detailed consultation to assess your oral health. Your dentist then creates a personalised plan, using digital imaging to show your predicted results. Beyond enhancing your appearance, a smile makeover can restore dental function, improve chewing, and boost your self-confidence. It changes not just your teeth, but your whole facial aesthetic.

Most makeovers combine two or three of the treatments below, rather than all of them. The table gives representative 2026 Pune ranges so you have a realistic sense of the figures before you visit. Your own plan depends on the treatments you actually need.

| **Treatment** | **Representative 2026 Pune Range** | **What It Addresses** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Porcelain veneers | 8,000 to 15,000 per tooth | Chips, gaps, shape, and stubborn colour |
| Composite bonding | 3,000 to 5,000 per tooth | Minor chips and small gaps |
| Teeth whitening | 8,000 to 20,000 | General staining and discolouration |
| Crowns | 6,000 to 15,000 per tooth | Broken, worn, or heavily filled teeth |
| Clear aligners or braces | 80,000 to 3,50,000 | Crooked or crowded teeth, corrected before cosmetic work |
| Gum reshaping | 5,000 to 10,000 | An uneven gum line or a gummy smile |

_Note: These are representative 2026 Pune ranges for guidance only. They are not Orion’s fixed fees. For your exact plan, book a consultation._

## Veneers in Focus: Porcelain vs Composite

When choosing between porcelain and composite veneers, the right choice depends on your budget, timeline, and aesthetic goals.

### Porcelain Veneers

Porcelain veneers are thin shells of medical-grade ceramic bonded to the front of the teeth.

*   **Appearance.** High translucency creates a natural, lifelike look.
*   **Durability.** A hard-wearing material that resists chipping and lasts 10 to 15 years.
*   **Stain resistance.** Highly resistant to coffee, tea, smoke, and dark foods.
*   **Process.** Requires two to three appointments and some permanent enamel removal.

### Composite Veneers

Composite veneers use a tooth-coloured engineered resin applied directly to the teeth.

*   **Appearance.** Good aesthetics, though it lacks porcelain’s realistic light reflection.
*   **Durability.** A softer material that is more prone to chipping and lasts 5 to 7 years.
*   **Stain resistance.** Absorbs stains over time and needs regular polishing.
*   **Process.** Completed in a single visit with minimal or no enamel removal.

### Key Comparison

| **Feature** | **Porcelain Veneers** | **Composite Veneers** |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Longevity | 10 to 15 years | 5 to 7 years |
| Reversibility | No (enamel is removed) | Yes (minimal prep) |
| Cost | Higher upfront investment | Lower initial cost |
| Repairability | Must be replaced if broken | Easily patched in-office |

![porcelain-veneers](https://oriondentalspecialities.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/porcelain-veneers-1008x1024.jpeg)

## See Your New Smile Before You Start

The ‘see your new smile before you start’ workflow relies on Digital Smile Design (DSD). This technology lets you preview and approve your results before any dental work begins. Here is how the step-by-step workflow operates.

### 1\. Data collection

Your dentist gathers high-resolution digital media of your face and teeth.

*   **Studio photography.** Captures your smile from multiple angles and facial expressions.
*   **Video clips.** Records how your teeth look while you speak and laugh naturally.
*   **Intraoral scanning.** Creates a 3D digital model of your teeth without messy moulds.

### 2\. Digital design

The dentist uses specialised software to plan your ideal smile proportions.

*   **Facial analysis.** Aligns your new teeth with your eyes, lips, and facial midline.
*   **Teeth customisation.** Adjusts the digital shape, height, width, and colour of each tooth.
*   **Cross-disciplinary planning.** Combines cosmetic design with structural and functional biology.

### 3\. The physical mock-up (the test drive)

You get to try on your new smile in real life before making a commitment.

*   **3D printing.** The digital design is printed into a physical 3D model.
*   **Temporary matrix.** A custom tray transfers temporary tooth-coloured resin over your real teeth.
*   **Live preview.** You can look in the mirror, talk, and take photos with your trial smile.

### 4\. Approval and execution

Once you approve the temporary look, the final transformation begins.

*   **Replication.** The approved mock-up serves as the exact blueprint for the lab.
*   **Fabrication.** Technicians create your permanent porcelain veneers or crowns to match.
*   **Delivery.** The dentist bonds the final restorations, matching your preview.

## What Decides Your Smile Makeover Cost

Your smile makeover cost depends on three primary factors: treatment complexity, material selection, and professional expertise.

*   **Treatment complexity.** The number of teeth involved and the extent of correction required directly affect the price. Combining multiple procedures, like pairing clear aligners with gum contouring, increases the overall cost.
*   **Material selection.** High-grade, durable materials like porcelain veneers carry a higher upfront price than direct composite resin bonding.
*   **Professional expertise.** Skilled cosmetic dentists and quality dental laboratories charge more for their artistry, digital simulation technology, and the time each case takes.

## How Long Does a Smile Makeover Take, and How Long Does It Last?

### The timeline: how long it takes

A smile makeover timeline depends entirely on the procedures you choose.

*   **Express makeovers (1 to 2 visits).** Treatments like teeth whitening, composite bonding, and gum contouring deliver results within a few days.
*   **Moderate makeovers (3 to 6 weeks).** Procedures that need lab fabrication, such as porcelain veneers, crowns, and bridges, take a few weeks to design, preview, and bond.
*   **Extended makeovers (6 to 24 months).** If your plan needs orthodontic alignment (like Invisalign) or dental implants to replace missing teeth, the process moves in phases over several months.

### The lifespan: how long it lasts

Your new smile is an investment, and different materials offer different lifespans.

*   **Composite bonding.** Typically lasts 3 to 7 years before the resin stains or chips and needs refreshing.
*   **Porcelain veneers and crowns.** Durable ceramic options regularly last 10 to 15 years, and often longer with good care.
*   **Teeth whitening.** Usually needs a touch-up every 6 to 12 months, depending on your diet.

### Factors that cut lifespan short

Your daily habits directly affect how long your results last.

*   **Bruxism (teeth grinding).** Unconscious grinding or clenching can crack porcelain and chip composite resin. A protective nightguard is important.
*   **Oral hygiene.** Veneers and crowns cannot decay, but the natural tooth underneath them can still get cavities if you skip brushing and flossing.
*   **Dietary choices.** Biting into hard foods like ice or hard candy can dislodge restorations, while frequent coffee, tea, or smoking will stain composite materials.

## Is a Smile Makeover Worth It?

Yes. A properly planned makeover can make a real difference to your confidence and works well on healthy teeth. That said, avoid cheap, rushed work. Poorly fitted restorations can cause serious and costly dental damage later, so careful planning matters as much as the treatment itself.

## Payment Options and EMI

A smile makeover is a significant investment, but the cost can be managed flexibly.

*   **Staged care.** Break your treatment into clinical phases to spread the expense over time.
*   **EMI options.** Monthly instalment plans can make treatment easier to budget for.
*   **In-house plans.** Divide payments between your initial preparation visit and your final fitting.

At [Orion Dental Specialities](https://oriondentalspecialities.com/contact/), we plan makeovers in stages and offer direct clinic instalment plans. Talk to us during your consultation to find a plan that works for you.

## Frequently Asked Questions

The cost of a full smile makeover depends on several factors. As a guide, a full set of composite veneers ranges from around 20,000 to 45,000, while a full set of ceramic veneers ranges from around 60,000 to 1,20,000. An examination and a personalised plan give you the accurate figure for your case.

Properly planned veneers remove only a very thin layer of enamel, and some conservative options remove almost none. The key is careful planning and a skilled hand. We always aim to keep as much healthy tooth as possible.

Porcelain veneers can last many years with good care, while composite bonding usually lasts a few years before it needs a refresh. Avoiding habits like biting nails or grinding, and keeping up good oral hygiene, helps them last longer.

## Conclusion

A smile makeover is a transformative investment in both your oral health and your self-confidence. By combining restorative and cosmetic procedures, such as teeth whitening, composite veneers, and ceramic veneers, it provides long-lasting results that enhance facial aesthetics and support overall well-being.

Invisalign Cost in Pune (2026): A Complete Price Guide
By Dr. Anagha Kanade Deshpande, MDS Orthodontics, Fellow of the World Federation of Orthodontists, Invisalign Certified Provider, practising at Orion Dental Specialities, Kothrud since 2020.
If you have been searching for Invisalign cost in Pune, you have probably seen figures that range from 80,000 to well past 3,00,000 with very little explanation. The gap is not a typo. The price of clear aligners depends on the brand you choose, the complexity of your case, and what the clinic actually includes in that number.
This guide explains what Invisalign costs in Pune in 2026, how branded aligners compare to Indian aligner brands in price, and what really drives the final figure. I am Dr. Anagha Kanade Deshpande, MDS Orthodontics, Fellow of the World Federation of Orthodontists, and Invisalign Certified Provider. I practice at Orion Dental Specialities in Kothrud, Pune, where I have been treating patients with clear aligners since 2020.
How Much Does Invisalign Cost in Pune? (The Quick Answer)
The exact cost depends on three things: the brand of aligner, the complexity of your case, and the number of aligner sets required. The table below reflects representative 2026 Pune ranges.
Aligner Type	Representative 2026 Pune Range	Best Suited For	
Invisalign (full treatment)	2,00,000 to 3,00,000	Moderate to complex cases needing predictable, fully planned movement	
Invisalign (express or lite, mild cases)	1,00,000 to 1,80,000	Minor crowding or spacing, shorter treatment	
Indian aligners	80,000 to 1,50,000	Budget-conscious patients with mild to moderate cases	
Note: These are representative 2026 Pune ranges and are not Orion’s fixed fees. For your exact quote, book a consultation.
What Your Invisalign Price Actually Includes at Orion Dental
A clear aligner fee is a package, not a single product. At Orion Dental Specialities, a properly supervised aligner plan covers the digital scan, the full treatment plan, all aligner sets, refinements if your teeth need extra fine-tuning, regular review visits with the orthodontist, the first set of retainers, and a dental kit.
Before you compare quotes from different clinics, always ask what is and what is not included. A lower headline number can sometimes mean retainers, refinements, or review visits are charged separately.
Invisalign vs Indian Aligners
The most important decision is not which brand of aligner you choose. It is choosing an orthodontist, a dentist who specialises in braces and tooth movement, to plan and supervise your treatment.
The choice of aligner brand then depends on the complexity of your case and your budget. Some aligner companies have invested many years in research and development, and their aligners perform more predictably in complex cases. For mild to moderate cases, Indian aligner brands can be a sensible and effective option.
Whatever brand is used, the key point is this: an orthodontist must plan and supervise the treatment from start to finish.
What Decides Your Clear Aligner Cost
Several real factors affect what you will actually pay. Here is what matters.
Case complexity. Mild crowding needs fewer aligners than a full bite correction. Fewer aligners means a lower cost.
Number of aligner sets and treatment length. Longer cases use more sets and more review visits, which increases the total.
Brand of aligner chosen. Some brands cost more than others.
Refinements. Some cases need an extra round of aligners to finish. Ask whether these are included in the original quote.
No Hidden Costs at Orion Dental. At our clinic, the things patients often forget to ask about are either covered in the cost or discussed clearly upfront before treatment starts. These include:
Retainers after treatment.
Replacement aligners if a set is lost.
Refinement aligners if extra fine-tuning is needed at the end.
Scans.
Invisalign vs Braces: Which Costs More?
Invisalign typically costs more than metal or ceramic braces, while Indian clear aligners can be priced similarly to ceramic braces. The right choice depends on your case and your lifestyle, not only on price. If you want to compare costs side by side, our braces cost guide has the full breakdown.
Are Cheap Online Aligners Worth It?
Mail-order or DIY aligners ordered without seeing an in-person orthodontist are not the same as clinic-supervised treatment. They can move teeth in unsafe ways or leave a bite problem worse than it was before. There is no specialist to step in if something goes wrong. Clinic-supervised clear aligner treatment costs more for a reason: safety and a healthy result come first. For more on this, see our post on the risks of online aligners.
Payment Options and EMI for Invisalign in Pune
At Orion Dental Specialities, clear aligner treatment starts from around 1,50,000 depending on the case, and we offer direct clinic instalment plans. Talk to us during your consultation about the payment schedule that works for you.
How to Get an Accurate Invisalign Quote for Your Case
The ranges in this guide are a starting point, not a quote. An accurate cost can only be given after an orthodontist examines your teeth and bite in person. Here is what happens at a consultation at Orion Dental Specialities.
Full orthodontic examination of the teeth and bite.
Digital scan, with no messy moulds.
A before and after smile simulation so you can see the likely result.
Discussion of suitable aligner options and timelines for your case.
A clear, itemised cost breakdown with no surprises.
Frequently Asked Questions
Is Invisalign more expensive than braces in Pune?
Invisalign usually costs more than metal or ceramic braces. However, Indian clear aligners can cost similar to ceramic braces. The right choice depends on the case and your lifestyle, not just the price.
Why is Invisalign more expensive than Indian aligners?
Invisalign uses globally researched material and detailed planning software, and requires certified training to deliver. The higher price reflects predictability and technology. Indian aligners can work well for suitable cases at a lower cost.
Can I get Invisalign on EMI in Pune?
Yes. Our clinic in Kothrud, Pune offers instalment plans tied to the treatment. Ask for the details during your consultation.
Does Invisalign cost more for complex cases?
Yes. Complex cases need more aligner sets and a longer treatment, which increases the cost. A mild case needs fewer aligners and costs less. An examination gives the accurate figure.
Are online or mail-order aligners cheaper, and are they safe?
They often look cheaper, but they are not supervised by an in-person orthodontist, which carries real risk to your teeth and bite. Clinic-supervised aligners cost more for a reason. Safety and a healthy result come first.
Conclusion
If you are researching Invisalign cost in Pune, the three things to take from this guide are: the price ranges vary by aligner brand and case complexity; the most important factor is choosing an orthodontist to plan and supervise your treatment; and an accurate quote can only come from an in-person examination.
If you are ready to find out what clear aligner treatment would cost for your specific case, book a consultation at Orion Dental Specialities in Kothrud. I will examine your teeth, walk you through your options, and give you a clear breakdown with no surprises.

Dental Crowns & Bridges in Pune: When You Need Each (2026)
By Dr. Rohan Deshpande, MDS Prosthodontics and Crown and Bridge, at Orion Dental Specialities, Kothrud.
Patients often walk into my clinic saying “I think I need a crown” when they actually need a bridge, or the other way around. Some need an implant instead. The difference matters because each procedure does something different, suits different cases, and costs differently.
I am Dr. Rohan Deshpande. I hold an MDS in Prosthodontics and Crown and Bridge, the discipline that literally specialises in these restorations. This guide will clarify what each procedure does, when each is the right choice, and what each costs in Pune in 2026.
Quick Answer: Crown vs Bridge in One Minute
A dental crown covers a single damaged or weak tooth. It is a custom-made cap that fits over the existing tooth, restoring its shape, strength, and appearance.
A dental bridge replaces one or more missing teeth. It uses the adjacent teeth as anchors, with crowns on each side supporting a false tooth (or teeth) in the middle.
A dental implant is a separate option that replaces missing teeth without involving the neighbouring teeth at all. We cover the crown vs bridge vs implant decision below.
When You Need a Dental Crown
Three common situations call for a crown.
After a Root Canal
Root canal treatment removes the nerve from a tooth. Without the nerve, the tooth becomes brittle and is at high risk of cracking. A crown protects the tooth and restores its strength. Most root canals are followed by a crown within 4 to 6 weeks. Skipping this step is one of the biggest reasons root canals fail clinically. The tooth fractures below the gum line and ends up needing extraction.
For a Cracked or Heavily Filled Tooth
If a tooth has lost more than half of its natural structure through a large cavity, a fracture, or multiple fillings stacked over time, a crown holds the remaining tooth together. Without it, the tooth often breaks under normal bite forces.
For Cosmetic Improvement
Crowns can transform the look of a tooth that is misshapen, discoloured, or worn down. This is one of the most common cosmetic dentistry treatments. We use porcelain or zirconia for visible teeth so the crown matches your natural tooth colour and translucency.
When You Need a Dental Bridge
Two scenarios make a bridge the right choice.
One or Two Missing Teeth with Healthy Neighbours
A traditional bridge uses crowns on either side of the gap to support a false tooth in the middle. The neighbouring teeth need to be healthy enough to act as anchors. They are filed down to fit the crowns. The whole process takes about 2 visits over 1 to 2 weeks.
When You Are Not a Candidate for Implants
Some patients cannot have implants due to bone loss, uncontrolled diabetes, smoking, or budget. A bridge is a reliable alternative that can last 10 to 15 years with good care. We discuss both options at the consultation so you have all the facts.
Types of Dental Crowns and Their Cost in Pune
Four crown types are commonly used in Pune. Each has trade-offs in cost, appearance, and durability.
Metal Crowns (4,500 to 8,000 rupees)
The strongest option, made of gold or base metal alloy. Best suited for back molars where strength matters more than appearance. Lifespan: 20 to 30 years. Not used for front teeth because of visibility.
Porcelain-Fused-to-Metal or PFM Crowns (7,500 to 12,000 rupees)
A metal core for strength with a porcelain outer layer for appearance. Good for back teeth and some front teeth. Lifespan: 10 to 15 years. Can show a dark line at the gum margin over time as gums recede slightly.
Zirconia Crowns (12,000 to 20,000 rupees)
All-ceramic, tooth-coloured, and extremely strong. Suits front and back teeth equally well. Lifespan: 15 to 20 years. Most patients at Orion choose this for the balance of strength and aesthetics.
E-Max or All-Ceramic Crowns (15,000 to 25,000 rupees)
The premium aesthetic crown, the most natural-looking option. Best for front teeth where appearance is critical. Lifespan: 10 to 15 years. Slightly less strong than zirconia, so not ideal for patients who grind their teeth.
Types of Dental Bridges and Their Cost in Pune
Four bridge types are common, suited to different scenarios.
Traditional Bridge (25,000 to 50,000 rupees for 3 units)
The most common type. Crowns on each side of the gap, false tooth in the middle. Strong, durable, lasts 10 to 15 years. Requires the adjacent teeth to be prepared.
Maryland Bridge (18,000 to 35,000 rupees)
Uses metal or porcelain wings bonded to the back of adjacent teeth instead of full crowns. Less invasive, no need to file down healthy teeth. Better for front teeth and lower bite-force areas.
Cantilever Bridge (20,000 to 35,000 rupees)
Uses just one adjacent tooth as an anchor instead of two. Used when only one neighbouring tooth is available. Less common today because of the lever forces it places on the single anchor tooth over time.
Implant-Supported Bridge (1,20,000 to 2,00,000 rupees for 3 units)
Uses 2 implants instead of natural teeth to anchor the bridge. Preserves your adjacent teeth completely. No filing down required. Lasts longer than traditional bridges (15 to 25 years). Best suited for patients missing 2 or more adjacent teeth who want the longevity of implants without an implant per tooth.
Crown vs Bridge vs Implant: Which Is Right for You?
The right choice depends on which tooth is involved, the health of your neighbouring teeth, your bone density, and your budget.
Crown: when you have a damaged, cracked, or heavily filled tooth that is still in your mouth. Restores the existing tooth.
Bridge: when you have one or more missing teeth with healthy neighbours that can act as anchors. Faster and cheaper than implants. Lifespan 10 to 15 years.
Implant: when you have one or more missing teeth and want the longest-lasting solution that preserves the neighbouring teeth. Higher upfront cost. Lifespan 25 to 30 years.
We assess all three at the consultation so you make an informed choice, not a pressured one.
What Happens at a Crown or Bridge Appointment
The typical process takes 2 visits over 1 to 2 weeks.
Clinical examination and digital scan or impression of the affected area.
Tooth preparation: filing down the tooth (for a crown) or the anchor teeth (for a bridge) to fit the new restoration.
Temporary crown or bridge fitted while the final one is being made.
The lab makes the final restoration in zirconia, PFM, or E-Max, usually 5 to 10 working days.
Final fitting, bite checked, cement applied. You leave with the permanent restoration in place.
A follow-up visit in 2 to 4 weeks to confirm fit and comfort.
How to Make Your Crown or Bridge Last Longer
Six habits will extend the lifespan of your restoration significantly.
Brush twice daily with a soft-bristle brush.
Use a water flosser or super-floss for bridges. Regular floss does not reach under the false tooth.
Avoid biting hard objects like ice, pen caps, and nuts.
Wear a night guard if you grind your teeth.
Visit for professional cleaning every 6 months.
Treat any underlying gum disease promptly. Gum recession is the biggest threat to a long-lasting crown.
Frequently Asked Questions
Q: How long do dental crowns and bridges last?
Zirconia crowns last 15 to 20 years. PFM crowns 10 to 15 years. Metal crowns 20 to 30 years. Traditional bridges 10 to 15 years. Implant-supported bridges 15 to 25 years. Lifespan depends on your oral hygiene, your diet, and whether you grind your teeth at night.
Q: Is a crown better than a filling?
It depends on how much of the tooth is damaged. Fillings work for small to medium cavities. When more than half the tooth is lost, a crown is needed to hold the remaining structure together. Your dentist will tell you which is right at the examination.
Q: Should I choose a bridge or an implant?
Implants preserve your neighbouring teeth and last longer, but cost more upfront and need sufficient bone density. Bridges are faster (2 visits versus 3 to 6 months) and cheaper, but require filing down healthy adjacent teeth. The right choice depends on your bone, your budget, and which teeth are involved.
Q: Is a crown procedure painful?
The procedure is done under local anaesthesia and is not painful during the work. Mild sensitivity for a few days after the temporary crown is fitted is normal. The final crown should not cause pain. Severe pain after fitting is not normal and should be reported.
Q: Can I eat normally with a bridge or crown?
Yes, after a short adjustment period of 3 to 7 days. Avoid extremely hard foods like raw carrots, hard candy, or ice in the first week. After that, normal eating is fine. With proper care, crowns and bridges work like natural teeth.
Conclusion
Crowns cover damaged teeth. Bridges replace missing teeth using neighbours as anchors. Implants are the long-term replacement option without involving neighbouring teeth. The right choice depends on your specific case, and that is why a clinical examination matters more than any online article.
If you are considering a crown, bridge, or implant, book a consultation at Orion Dental Specialities in Kothrud. I will walk you through every option and recommend what suits your case, with no pressure to decide on the day.

Root canal treatment removes the nerve from a tooth. Without the nerve, the tooth becomes brittle and is at high risk of cracking. A crown protects the tooth and restores its strength. Most root canals are followed by a crown within 4 to 6 weeks. Skipping this step is one of the biggest reasons root canals fail clinically. The tooth fractures below the gum line and ends up needing extraction.

### **For a Cracked or Heavily Filled Tooth**

If a tooth has lost more than half of its natural structure through a large cavity, a fracture, or multiple fillings stacked over time, a crown holds the remaining tooth together. Without it, the tooth often breaks under normal bite forces.

### **For Cosmetic Improvement**

Crowns can transform the look of a tooth that is misshapen, discoloured, or worn down. This is one of the most common cosmetic dentistry treatments. We use porcelain or zirconia for visible teeth so the crown matches your natural tooth colour and translucency.

## **When You Need a Dental Bridge**

Two scenarios make a bridge the right choice.

### **One or Two Missing Teeth with Healthy Neighbours**

A traditional bridge uses crowns on either side of the gap to support a false tooth in the middle. The neighbouring teeth need to be healthy enough to act as anchors. They are filed down to fit the crowns. The whole process takes about 2 visits over 1 to 2 weeks.

### **When You Are Not a Candidate for Implants**

Some patients cannot have implants due to bone loss, uncontrolled diabetes, smoking, or budget. A bridge is a reliable alternative that can last 10 to 15 years with good care. We discuss both options at the consultation so you have all the facts.

## **Types of Dental Crowns and Their Cost in Pune**

Four crown types are commonly used in Pune. Each has trade-offs in [cost](https://oriondentalspecialities.com/dental-implants-cost-pune/), appearance, and durability.

### **Metal Crowns (4,500 to 8,000 rupees)**

The strongest option, made of gold or base metal alloy. Best suited for back molars where strength matters more than appearance. Lifespan: 20 to 30 years. Not used for front teeth because of visibility.

### **Porcelain-Fused-to-Metal or PFM Crowns (7,500 to 12,000 rupees)**

A metal core for strength with a porcelain outer layer for appearance. Good for back teeth and some front teeth. Lifespan: 10 to 15 years. Can show a dark line at the gum margin over time as gums recede slightly.

### **Zirconia Crowns (12,000 to 20,000 rupees)**

All-ceramic, tooth-coloured, and extremely strong. Suits front and back teeth equally well. Lifespan: 15 to 20 years. Most patients at Orion choose this for the balance of strength and aesthetics.

### **E-Max or All-Ceramic Crowns (15,000 to 25,000 rupees)**

The premium aesthetic crown, the most natural-looking option. Best for front teeth where appearance is critical. Lifespan: 10 to 15 years. Slightly less strong than zirconia, so not ideal for patients who grind their teeth.

## **Types of Dental Bridges and Their Cost in Pune**

Four bridge types are common, suited to different scenarios.

### **Traditional Bridge (25,000 to 50,000 rupees for 3 units)**

The most common type. Crowns on each side of the gap, false tooth in the middle. Strong, durable, lasts 10 to 15 years. Requires the adjacent teeth to be prepared.

### **Maryland Bridge (18,000 to 35,000 rupees)**

Uses metal or porcelain wings bonded to the back of adjacent teeth instead of full crowns. Less invasive, no need to file down healthy teeth. Better for front teeth and lower bite-force areas.

### **Cantilever Bridge (20,000 to 35,000 rupees)**

Uses just one adjacent tooth as an anchor instead of two. Used when only one neighbouring tooth is available. Less common today because of the lever forces it places on the single anchor tooth over time.

### **Implant-Supported Bridge (1,20,000 to 2,00,000 rupees for 3 units)**

Uses 2 implants instead of natural teeth to anchor the bridge. Preserves your adjacent teeth completely. No filing down required. Lasts longer than traditional bridges (15 to 25 years). Best suited for patients missing 2 or more adjacent teeth who want the longevity of implants without an implant per tooth.

## **Crown vs Bridge vs Implant: Which Is Right for You?**

The right choice depends on which tooth is involved, the health of your neighbouring teeth, your bone density, and your budget.

*   Crown: when you have a damaged, cracked, or heavily filled tooth that is still in your mouth. Restores the existing tooth.
*   Bridge: when you have one or more missing teeth with healthy neighbours that can act as anchors. Faster and cheaper than implants. Lifespan 10 to 15 years.
*   Implant: when you have one or more missing teeth and want the longest-lasting solution that preserves the neighbouring teeth. Higher upfront cost. Lifespan 25 to 30 years.

We assess all three at the consultation so you make an informed choice, not a pressured one.

## **What Happens at a Crown or Bridge Appointment**

The typical process takes 2 visits over 1 to 2 weeks.

1.  Clinical examination and digital scan or impression of the affected area.
2.  Tooth preparation: filing down the tooth (for a crown) or the anchor teeth (for a bridge) to fit the new restoration.
3.  Temporary crown or bridge fitted while the final one is being made.
4.  The lab makes the final restoration in zirconia, PFM, or E-Max, usually 5 to 10 working days.
5.  Final fitting, bite checked, cement applied. You leave with the permanent restoration in place.
6.  A follow-up visit in 2 to 4 weeks to confirm fit and comfort.

## **How to Make Your Crown or Bridge Last Longer**

Six habits will extend the lifespan of your restoration significantly.

*   Brush twice daily with a soft-bristle brush.
*   Use a water flosser or super-floss for bridges. Regular floss does not reach under the false tooth.
*   Avoid biting hard objects like ice, pen caps, and nuts.
*   Wear a night guard if you grind your teeth.
*   Visit for professional cleaning every 6 months.
*   Treat any underlying gum disease promptly. Gum recession is the biggest threat to a long-lasting crown.

## **Frequently Asked Questions**

### **Q: How long do dental crowns and bridges last?**

Zirconia crowns last 15 to 20 years. PFM crowns 10 to 15 years. Metal crowns 20 to 30 years. Traditional bridges 10 to 15 years. Implant-supported bridges 15 to 25 years. Lifespan depends on your oral hygiene, your diet, and whether you grind your teeth at night.

### **Q: Is a crown better than a filling?**

It depends on how much of the tooth is damaged. Fillings work for small to medium cavities. When more than half the tooth is lost, a crown is needed to hold the remaining structure together. Your dentist will tell you which is right at the examination.

### **Q: Should I choose a bridge or an implant?**

Implants preserve your neighbouring teeth and last longer, but cost more upfront and need sufficient bone density. Bridges are faster (2 visits versus 3 to 6 months) and cheaper, but require filing down healthy adjacent teeth. The right choice depends on your bone, your budget, and which teeth are involved.

### **Q: Is a crown procedure painful?**

The procedure is done under local anaesthesia and is not painful during the work. Mild sensitivity for a few days after the temporary crown is fitted is normal. The final crown should not cause pain. Severe pain after fitting is not normal and should be reported.

### **Q: Can I eat normally with a bridge or crown?**

Yes, after a short adjustment period of 3 to 7 days. Avoid extremely hard foods like raw carrots, hard candy, or ice in the first week. After that, normal eating is fine. With proper care, crowns and bridges work like natural teeth.

## **Conclusion**

Crowns cover damaged teeth. Bridges replace missing teeth using neighbours as anchors. Implants are the long-term replacement option without involving neighbouring teeth. The right choice depends on your specific case, and that is why a clinical examination matters more than any online article.

Dental Implants Cost in Pune 2026: Full Price Guide
Cost of Dental Implants in Pune (2026): Single Tooth, Multiple Teeth, and Full Arch Compared
By Dr. Rohan Deshpande, MDS Prosthodontics and Crown and Bridge, Implantologist at Orion Dental Specialities, Kothrud.
Implant pricing in Pune is confusing. The same procedure can be quoted at 35,000 rupees by one clinic and 80,000 by another, and the difference is not always reflected in quality. As a prosthodontist who places implants daily, I want to give you a straight answer about what each option actually costs in 2026, what affects the price, and how to spot value beyond just the headline number.
I am Dr. Rohan Deshpande. I hold an MDS in Prosthodontics and Crown and Bridge, and I have been placing implants at Orion Dental Specialities in Kothrud since 2020.
How Much Do Dental Implants Cost in Pune? Quick Answer
The cost of a dental implant in Pune depends on the implant brand, the crown material, the complexity of your case, and the clinic’s expertise. Here are the most common single-tooth options most patients consider.
Implant Option	Typical Range	
Single Tooth Implant (Brazilian implant + crown)	35,000 to 40,000 rupees	
Single Tooth Implant (European implant + crown, e.g., Straumann)	45,000 to 65,000 rupees	
For multiple-tooth and full-arch options, costs scale up significantly. We cover those below.
What Decides Your Implant Cost in Pune
Six factors shape what you actually pay.
Implant Brand
Brazilian implant systems start from around 35,000 to 40,000 rupees. European brands like Straumann are 45,000 to 60,000 rupees. Both deliver excellent long-term results when placed by a trained implantologist. The choice often comes down to specific clinical features and patient preference, not just cost.
Crown Material
The crown that sits on top of the implant is often quoted separately. PFM crowns 4,500 to 8,000 rupees. Zirconia crowns 12,000 to 20,000. E-Max ceramic 15,000 to 25,000. The crown material affects appearance and longevity, especially for visible front teeth.
Bone Grafting
If your bone is thin or has resorbed after long-standing tooth loss, a graft is needed before the implant can be placed. Adds 15,000 to 40,000 rupees depending on the volume of graft needed.
Sinus Lift
For upper back teeth implants, the proximity of the sinus floor sometimes requires a sinus lift procedure. Adds 20,000 to 50,000 rupees.
Number of Implants
Full arch solutions like All-on-4 use 4 implants to anchor a complete fixed set of teeth. The per-implant cost is lower in bulk, but the total cost is higher.
Surgeon’s Experience and Specialisation
A prosthodontist or trained implantologist typically prices higher than a general dentist, but the case is planned more thoroughly with CBCT imaging, restorative-led planning, and prosthetic outcome in mind from day one.
Single Tooth Implant: The Most Common Option
A single tooth implant is a titanium post placed in the jawbone, topped with an abutment and a crown. It replaces one missing tooth without involving the neighbouring teeth.
It is the right option when you have one missing tooth and the adjacent teeth are healthy. The traditional process takes 3 to 6 months: one surgery to place the implant, a healing phase for osseointegration where bone fuses to the implant, and a second visit to fit the crown. In suitable cases, same-day or immediate-loading techniques can collapse this timeline.
Cost in Pune for the complete single-tooth treatment ranges from 35,000 rupees with a Brazilian implant to 65,000 rupees with a European brand. Lifespan with proper care: 25 to 30 years.
Multiple Tooth Implants: Bridges vs Individual Implants
If you are missing two or more adjacent teeth, you have two main options.
Option 1: an implant-supported bridge. Two implants are placed at either end of the gap, and a 3 or 4 tooth bridge is anchored on top. Spreads the bite force evenly and saves on cost compared to placing an implant per tooth.
Option 2: individual implants for each tooth. More expensive, but preserves more bone over the long term because each tooth has its own implant stimulating the bone beneath.
The right choice depends on bone density, the location of the missing teeth, your budget, and your long-term plan. We discuss both at the consultation with the CBCT scan in front of us.
Full Arch Implants (All-on-4, All-on-6)
For patients missing most or all of their teeth in one arch (upper or lower jaw), full-arch implant solutions like All-on-4 and All-on-6 are the modern alternative to dentures. A complete fixed set of teeth is anchored to 4 or 6 strategically placed implants.
Faster than traditional implant-per-tooth approaches. More comfortable than removable dentures. No removal needed: the teeth stay in place.
Cost in Pune:
All-on-4: 1,80,000 to 3,00,000 rupees per arch
All-on-6: 2,20,000 to 3,50,000 rupees per arch
Candidacy requires sufficient bone density (or graft if needed), healthy gums, and overall good health. Recovery is faster than expected. Most patients return to work within 3 to 5 days after surgery.
Same-Day Implants: A Specialty at Orion
Same-day or immediate-loading implants allow you to walk out with a temporary crown on the same day as surgery, instead of waiting 3 to 6 months. Not every patient is a candidate. The technique requires sufficient bone density, good gum health, and a healthy bite to be successful.
Cost is similar to traditional implants, but the overall treatment timeline collapses from 3 to 6 months down to 1 to 2 weeks for the visible result. The final crown is fitted a few months later once the implant is fully integrated.
Whether you are a candidate is a clinical decision made after a CBCT scan, not a quotable answer over the phone. We assess every case individually.
What is Included in Our Implant Cost at Orion Dental
Transparency is what most patients value most. Here is what is in your quote at Orion and what may be additional.
Always included: consultation, digital scans, OPG, treatment planning, the surgery, the implant, the abutment, and the crown.
May be additional, depending on case: bone grafting, sinus lift, extractions of compromised teeth before surgery, sedation if requested, and additional follow-up cleanings.
Always provided upfront: a clear written quote before the procedure starts. We do not change pricing midway through treatment.
Hidden Costs to Ask About at Any Clinic
Before you commit anywhere in Pune, ask:
Is the crown cost included in the implant quote, or is it separate?
Are follow-up cleaning visits charged per visit after surgery?
Is GST applied on top of the quoted price, or included?
Are X-rays, CBCT scans, and impressions charged separately?
Are warranty or maintenance plans sold separately, and what do they cover?
These questions catch the common surprises.
What Happens at Your Implant Consultation
Your first visit is about 60 minutes. We carry out a clinical examination, take an OPG and possibly a CBCT scan depending on the case, discuss bone health and any graft needs, and create a complete treatment plan with timeline. By the end you will have an itemised cost estimate with no surprises.
We do not ask you to commit on the day. You can take the plan home and decide.
Frequently Asked Questions
Q: Are dental implants worth the cost?
In most cases, yes. Implants last 25 to 30 years with proper care, while bridges typically need replacement every 10 to 12 years. Implants also prevent bone loss in the jaw, bone that naturally resorbs after tooth loss. The upfront cost is higher, but the long-term value is generally better.
Q: Why is one clinic in Pune quoting 35,000 rupees and another 60,000 for the same implant?
Usually two reasons. First, the implant brand differs: Brazilian or other budget systems versus European brands like Straumann. Second, the cheaper quote may not include the crown, abutment, or follow-up visits. Always ask for an itemised quote that lists exactly what is included.
Q: How long does a dental implant procedure take?
Traditional implants take 3 to 6 months from start to finish, with two main surgical phases separated by a healing period. Same-day or immediate-loading implants can be completed in 1 to 2 weeks for suitable patients. We confirm your specific timeline at the consultation after CBCT imaging.
Q: Are dental implants painful?
The procedure itself is performed under local anaesthesia and is not painful during surgery. Patients typically report mild discomfort and some swelling for 3 to 5 days afterward, similar to a tooth extraction. Over-the-counter painkillers manage this well. Severe pain is not normal and should be reported immediately.
Q: Can I get implants on EMI in Pune?
Yes. We offer clinic EMI tied to surgical phases, plus credit card EMI through partner banks. No-cost EMI options may be available depending on your bank’s offerings. Confirm options during your consultation.
Conclusion
Dental implant costs in Pune vary widely based on the implant brand, the crown material, case complexity, and the clinic’s expertise. The cheapest quote is rarely the best value, and the most expensive is not automatically the best either. What matters is what is included, who is placing the implant, and whether the treatment plan is genuinely tailored to your case.
If you want a clear, itemised quote for your case, book a consultation at Orion Dental Specialities in Kothrud. I will walk you through every option, with no surprises.
